objects.description: Key data class identifier handle type. This header file does not define the underlying struct/typedef; it only exposes a family of macros that alias to getter functions returning xmlSecKeyDataId for various algorithms. The actual xmlSecKeyDataId type is defined elsewhere in xmlsec headers.
Key data store class identifier handle type. This header only defines a macro alias for the X509 store class; the base type is defined elsewhere.

Transform class identifier handle type. This header defines many macro aliases mapping to functions that return xmlSecTransformId for specific algorithms. The base type is defined elsewhere in xmlsec.
Opaque name and pointer typedefs for the DSig Reference processing context struct defined later in this header. Use xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxPtr to reference instances.
Enumeration indicating overall XML Digital Signature processing status: unknown, succeeded, or invalid.
Enumeration describing a more specific failure reason for a signature operation (reference, signature, key not found, or unknown).

Digital Signature processing context. Holds configuration, chosen/default transform IDs, key info contexts, and results for processing a dsig:Signature. Caller typically creates with xmlSecDSigCtxCreate or initializes an existing instance, configures flags and allowed transforms, and then calls xmlSecDSigCtxSign or xmlSecDSigCtxVerify. Destruction via xmlSecDSigCtxDestroy or Finalize for stack instances.
Enumeration specifying whether a Reference node originates from SignedInfo or Manifest.

Processing context for a single dsig:Reference. Links to the owning xmlSecDSigCtx, records origin (SignedInfo or Manifest), transform chain, digest method, computed digest, and status. Create with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxCreate or Initialize, process a node with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxProcessNode, and destroy/finalize accordingly.
Enumeration selecting processing mode for XML Encryption: handling an <enc:EncryptedData/> element or an <enc:EncryptedKey/> element.
Enumeration describing the reason an XML Encryption operation failed. Values include unknown and key-not-found. Note: only these two reasons are defined in this header.

XML Encryption processing context that holds configuration, state, and results for encrypt/decrypt operations, including key info contexts, transforms, default method, selected key, result buffer/flags, attributes from EncryptedData/EncryptedKey, and pointers to relevant XML nodes.
Pointer-to-pointer to libxml2 xmlNode. Only referenced here; not defined in this header. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.
Pointer-to-pointer to libxml2 xmlDoc. Only referenced; not defined here. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.
Identifier/handle for an xmlsec transform. Only referenced; not defined here. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.
libxml2 unsigned char type for XML strings. Only referenced; not defined here. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.
xmlsec size type. Only referenced; not defined here. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.
xmlsec byte type. Only referenced; not defined here. Skipped per instruction if strictly requiring definitions in this file.

Holds the content parsed from a <dsig:X509Data/> child element in XML Signature, such as X509Certificate, X509CRL, X509SKI, X509SubjectName, X509IssuerSerial, and dsig11:X509Digest. Not all fields are necessarily set at once. Buffers (cert, crl, ski, digest) are xmlSecBuffer values containing raw bytes; string fields are xmlChar* and likely UTF-8. Memory ownership/lifetime rules are not documented here; typically allocated and managed by xmlsec routines. Details of xmlSecBuffer/xmlChar come from the wider xmlsec/libxml APIs.
Typedef alias to struct _xmlSecKeyX509DataValue. Provides the public name for the X509 data value structure used by xmlsec APIs.
Enumeration selecting operation mode for KeyInfo processing: read a <dsig:KeyInfo/> element or write one.

Context for reading or writing <dsig:KeyInfo/>. Holds flags, mode, keys manager, enabled key data list, transform contexts for RetrievalMethod and KeyInfoReference, optional encryption context, X509 verification parameters, recursion level limits, and current key requirements. Used across the xmlsec KeyInfo APIs.

Typedefs declaring the key class type and its identifier alias. xmlSecKeyKlass represents a vtable-like descriptor for xmlsec keys; xmlSecKeyId is a pointer alias to such a class. Full struct _xmlSecKeyKlass is not defined in this header.

Typedefs declaring the key store class (klass) type and its identifier alias. xmlSecKeyStoreKlass describes operations for a key store; xmlSecKeyStoreId is a pointer alias to an instance of the klass. The full struct is defined below in this header.

Typedefs declaring the structure holding X.509-related key identification data and its pointer alias. The actual struct _xmlSecKeyX509DataValue is only forward-declared here; its layout is not provided in this header.

The keys manager object that owns a primary keys store and a list of key data stores and provides a callback to resolve keys from a dsig:KeyInfo node. It orchestrates key lookup and data store management.

Opaque key store object header embedding a klass id and reserved fields. Concrete stores allocate at least objSize bytes as dictated by their klass. Used by the keys manager to manage collections of keys.

Vtable (klass) describing a key store implementation: sizes, name, init/finalize, and lookup methods (by name and from X509 data). Concrete key stores expose a singleton instance of this struct and set objSize to the store object size.
Function pointer type for callbacks that parse a dsig:KeyInfo node to produce an xmlSecKey. Used by xmlSecKeysMngr to resolve keys.
Function pointer type for store-specific initialization routine. Returns 0 on success, negative on error.
Function pointer type for store-specific finalization (destructor) routine.
Function pointer type for a store-specific key lookup by name. Returns a key the caller must destroy or NULL.
Function pointer type for a store-specific key lookup using X.509 data. Returns a key the caller must destroy or NULL.
Function pointer type used by the Simple Keys Store to adopt (take ownership of) a key into the store.

Class/descriptor (id) for xmlSec key data types. Instances describe concrete key-data implementations (e.g., RSA key value). xmlSecKeyDataId is a pointer alias to this const klass. It provides sizes, name, allowed usages, XML mapping, and method table for lifecycle, I/O, and debug. Constructed by providers; used by framework functions to create/manage xmlSecKeyData objects.

Class/descriptor (id) for key data stores. A store keeps shared resources (e.g., trusted certs). The klass supplies size, name, and init/finalize callbacks. xmlSecKeyDataStoreId is a pointer alias to this const klass.
Opaque list type for holding xmlSecKeyData (or their ids) as defined by the xmlsec list framework. Only forward-declared here; definition is elsewhere.

Bitmask type describing allowed usages for a key data implementation (e.g., KeyInfo read/write, RetrievalMethod, etc.). Pointer form is rarely used directly; values are combined with the defined macros.
Bitmask describing key characteristics (public/private/symmetric, session/permanent, trusted). Used to label or request key properties.

objects.definition:
typedef enum {
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatUnknown = 0,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatBinary,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatPem,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatDer,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatPkcs8Pem,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatPkcs8Der,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatPkcs12,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatCertPem,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatCertDer,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatEngine,
    xmlSecKeyDataFormatStore
} xmlSecKeyDataFormat;
objects.description: Enumeration of supported key data external formats (binary, PEM/DER, PKCS8/12, cert, engine, store).

Runtime key data object holding crypto material or metadata (e.g., key value, X509, PGP). The id points to its xmlSecKeyDataKlass defining behavior. Created/destroyed via API; contents managed by klass methods. Reserved fields are for future use.
Runtime store object for key-data-related shared state (e.g., certificate stores). Managed via its klass id; reserved fields for future expansion.
Typedef representing a bitmask of key usage flags within XMLSec. Values are combined with bitwise OR using the xmlSecKeyUsage* macros defined in this header. Exact size is unsigned int.
Describes an application/identifier pair indicating where or by whom a key can be used. Provides fields for application and identifier strings and reserved pointers for future use.
Specifies requirements for selecting or generating a key, including desired key value class, type, usage flags, bit size, and a list of xmlSecKeyUseWith entries.
Represents a cryptographic key with optional name, primary value (xmlSecKeyData), associated auxiliary data list, usage flags, and validity interval (not before/after).

Type identifier (klass) for lists of xmlSecKeyUseWith pointers, used by the generic xmlSecPtrList framework. Note: xmlSecPtrListId is defined elsewhere; this header provides the accessor for the specific list kind.

Type identifier (klass) for lists of xmlSecKey pointers, used by the generic xmlSecPtrList framework. Note: xmlSecPtrListId is defined elsewhere; this header provides the accessor for the specific list kind.

Type alias pair: xmlSecTransformKlass is the const-qualified struct type describing a transform class (vtable/metadata). xmlSecTransformId is a pointer to const xmlSecTransformKlass and is used as the identifier for a transform implementation.
Enumeration of transform execution status codes used to track progress and results for a transform or transform chain.
Enumeration indicating whether a transform is being used to push data through or pop data from the chain (or unknown).
Enumeration specifying the transform operation being performed (encode/decode, sign/verify, encrypt/decrypt).
Bitmask type describing allowed URI categories for transform data sources (e.g., empty, same-document, local, remote). Flags are defined via xmlSecTransformUriType* macros.
Bitmask type describing transform data kinds (unknown, binary, XML). Values are provided by xmlSecTransformDataType* macros.
Bitmask type describing allowed usages/roles for a transform (e.g., DSig Transform, CanonicalizationMethod, DigestMethod, etc.).
Function pointer typedef for a callback invoked after creating the transforms chain but before execution to validate/adjust the chain. Return 0 on success, negative to abort execution.

Execution context for a transforms chain, holding configuration (flags, allowed URIs, enabled transforms, callback), linkage to parent key info context, results (buffer/status), source URI/xpointer, and head/tail of the chain.

Represents a single transform instance in a chain, including identity (klass id), operation, status, XML context node, chain links, I/O buffers for binary and XML data, expected output size, and flags.
Per-transform initialization function pointer. Returns 0 on success, negative on error.
Per-transform finalize/destroy function pointer.
Method to query input/output data types for a transform in a given mode.
Method to read/parse transform configuration from an XML node.
Method to write transform configuration/state to an XML node.
Method to declare key requirements for a transform.
Method to set a key for transform usage.

                                                                 const xmlSecByte* data,

objects.description: Method to verify a transform's output (used by digest/signature transforms). Sets status in the transform.

                                                                 const xmlSecByte* data,
                                                                 xmlSecSize dataSize,

objects.description: Method to pop binary data from previous transform and return results.
Method to push XML node sets through a transform.
Method to pop/process XML node sets from previous transform and return results.
Low-level chunked execution method used by default push/pop implementations.
Vtable/metadata descriptor for a transform implementation, including name, href, usage flags, and method pointers for lifecycle and I/O operations.

Identifier type for an xmlsec transform class; used here via the macro xmlSecTransformInputURIId that expands to xmlSecTransformInputURIGetKlass(). This header does not define the type; it only references it to expose the Input URI transform class id.
Pointer-to-transform instance handle used by xmlsec to operate on a concrete transform object. This header references it in Input URI open/close functions but does not define the underlying struct.

Identifier for an xmlsec transform class. In this header, xmlSecTransformXmlParserId is a macro that resolves to xmlSecTransformXmlParserGetKlass(), which returns the transform class for the XML parser transform. The underlying type is defined elsewhere (in xmlsec/transforms.h); this header only exposes the specific transform id for the XML parser transform.

Binary data buffer used by XML Security Library to hold and manage arbitrary bytes. Fields track data pointer, current size, allocated capacity, and allocation strategy. Created/destroyed via the xmlSecBuffer* APIs in this header; when embedded or stack-allocated, use Initialize/Finalize. Ownership: functions operating on this type manage its internal memory; callers must respect create/destroy and init/finalize pairs.

Enumeration selecting allocation strategy for buffers/lists: Exact minimizes allocated memory; Double grows capacity geometrically to reduce realloc/malloc calls. Used by xmlSecBuffer (and xmlSecList elsewhere).

Typedefs declaring the opaque/public names for the _xmlSecBuffer struct and its pointer type. The full struct is defined later in this header. xmlSecBuffer is the canonical type name and xmlSecBufferPtr is a pointer alias.

Enhanced XML node set object aggregating a libxml2 node set (xmlNodeSetPtr) with additional semantics: set type, set operation, and links to sibling/child xmlSecNodeSet objects to represent composite sets. Manages an associated xmlDocPtr with optional ownership via destroyDoc. Used to build, combine, traverse, and debug node sets for XMLSec processing.

Enumeration of node set semantics determining how the nodes field (and optionally children) are interpreted: normal, inverted relative to the document, tree-based inclusion with/without comments, tree-based inversion, or a list of child node sets.
Enumeration of set operations used when combining node sets: intersection, subtraction, and union.

objects.definition:
typedef int (*xmlSecNodeSetWalkCallback)                (xmlSecNodeSetPtr nset,
                                                         xmlNodePtr cur,
                                                         xmlNodePtr parent,
                                                         void* data);
objects.description: Function pointer type for callbacks invoked during node-set walking. Should return 0 on success or a negative value to stop traversal with error. Receives the node set, current node, its parent, and user data.

Klass/virtual-method table describing how a list manages its items: duplication, destruction, and debug dumping. xmlSecPtrListId is an alias type used to identify a particular klass instance (e.g., string list).
Dynamic array of xmlSecPtr elements with a klass (id) that defines item lifecycle and debug behavior. Manages capacity, size, and allocation mode.
Function pointer type for duplicating a list item. Returns a new copy of the given item or NULL on error.
Function pointer type for destroying a list item instance owned by a list klass.
Function pointer type for dumping debug information about a list item to a FILE*; also used for XML-style dump in klass.

xmlSecBn is a big-number container implemented as an alias of xmlSecBuffer. It stores the big number as a byte buffer and provides utilities for initialization, destruction, formatting (base64, hex, decimal), arithmetic (mul/div/add), byte-order reversal, comparison, and XML node value import/export. Since it aliases xmlSecBuffer, its memory management follows the buffer semantics; creation uses xmlSecBnCreate and destruction uses xmlSecBnDestroy, or Initialize/Finalize for stack-allocated instances.
Enumeration specifying the textual/binary encoding used when converting big numbers to/from strings and XML nodes: base64-encoded blob, hexadecimal string, or decimal string.

Opaque Base64 processing context used by the XML Security Library to perform streaming Base64 encoding or decoding with a configurable line width. The actual struct layout is not defined in this header (incomplete type), indicating it is managed internally by the library and should be created/destroyed via the provided API.

Tag name for the incomplete struct that backs xmlSecBase64Ctx. The concrete fields are not exposed here. Treat as an opaque handle; allocate via xmlSecBase64CtxCreate or initialize user storage with xmlSecBase64CtxInitialize, and cleanup with xmlSecBase64CtxDestroy or xmlSecBase64CtxFinalize.
Structure mapping a QName (namespace href + local part) to an integer value, used for QName <-> integer conversions in xmlsec trees.
Typedef representing a bitmask value used with QName <-> bitmask conversion helpers. Underlying type is unsigned int.
Structure mapping a QName (namespace href + local part) to a bitmask value, used for QName <-> bitmask conversions.

Identifier (klass) for the Memory Buffer transform. The macro xmlSecTransformMemBufId expands to a call to xmlSecTransformMemBufGetKlass(), which returns the transform class object used by xmlsec to register/instantiate the MemBuf transform.

Accessor returning the internal xmlSecBuffer associated with a MemBuf transform instance. Useful to read or manipulate the in-memory buffer managed by the transform. The underlying xmlSecBuffer type is declared elsewhere and not defined in this header.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only contains include guards, conditional includes, and preprocessor logic to select a crypto backend and include its headers. All types referenced are defined in other headers, not here.

Opaque handle to a table of dynamically loaded crypto backend functions used by xmlsec. The struct is forward-declared here; its internal fields are defined elsewhere. It represents the set of function pointers that a crypto plugin provides to register key data classes and transforms with xmlsec at runtime.
Generic void pointer typedef used throughout the library for opaque pointer passing. It aliases void* and carries no ownership semantics by itself.

objects.description: Unsigned size type used by the library; typedef of size_t with accompanying min/max/printf-format macros.
One-byte unsigned data type, typically used for raw buffers and octets.
Forward declaration of key data object holding a specific key material representation. Only an incomplete type is provided here; definition is elsewhere.
Forward declaration of a key data store (repository for key-related data). Incomplete type in this header.
Forward declaration of KeyInfo processing context used during key resolution and serialization. Incomplete here.
Forward declaration of a cryptographic key object. Incomplete type here.
Forward declaration of a key store (container for keys). Incomplete in this header.
Forward declaration of the keys manager that orchestrates key stores and key resolution. Incomplete here.
Forward declaration of a transform (e.g., digest, signature, encryption transforms). Incomplete in this header.
Forward declaration of a transform execution context. Incomplete here.
Conditional forward declaration of the XML Digital Signature processing context. Present only when XMLDSIG is enabled. Incomplete here.
Conditional forward declaration of the XML Encryption processing context. Present only when XMLENC is enabled. Incomplete here.
Enumeration selecting version check mode: exact match or ABI-compatible. Used with xmlSecCheckVersionExt.

typedef void (*xmlSecErrorsCallback)                            (const char* file,

                                                                 const char* func,

objects.description: Function pointer type for xmlsec error-reporting callbacks. Implementations receive the source file, line, function name, error object and subject strings, a numeric reason code, and an optional message. Used with xmlSecErrorsSetCallback to install a custom error handler.

OpenSSL I/O abstraction type referenced by this header. It is only forward-declared via the included OpenSSL headers and not defined here. Included for completeness but per instructions, since it is not defined in this header, no definition is available.
Pointer type for an xmlsec key object, referenced by functions in this header. The actual type/typedef is defined in xmlsec/keys.h, not in this header, thus no definition text is present here.
Pointer type to the xmlsec Keys Manager object, referenced by this header for manager initialization and loading operations. It is defined in xmlsec/keysmngr.h, not in this header.
Pointer type to xmlsec KeyInfo processing context, referenced but defined elsewhere (xmlsec/keys.h). No definition available in this header.
Typedef for an unsigned byte type used for binary buffers; referenced here but defined elsewhere (xmlsec/xmlsec.h). Not defined in this header.
Typedef for an unsigned size type used by xmlsec; referenced here but defined elsewhere (xmlsec/xmlsec.h). Not defined in this header.
Bitmask/enum type describing key data categories (public, private, session, etc.). It is referenced for function parameters but defined elsewhere (xmlsec/keys.h). Not defined in this header.
Enum identifying key/cert encoding formats (pem, der, pkcs8, etc.). Referenced here but defined elsewhere (xmlsec/keys.h or xmlsec/transforms.h). Not defined in this header.
Macro alias for the OpenSSL STACK_OF(X509) type, representing a stack (vector) of X509 certificates. This header only defines the macro, not a new struct or typedef.
Macro alias for the OpenSSL STACK_OF(X509_CRL) type, representing a stack of X509 certificate revocation lists. This header only defines the macro, not a new struct or typedef.

OpenSSL public/private key container type referenced by this header. It is declared in <openssl/evp.h> and not defined here. Included because it appears in the function prototypes, but it is not defined in this header; therefore no further details are available from this file.
Opaque pointer to an xmlsec key object, declared in <xmlsec/keys.h>. It is only referenced in this header and not defined here.
Opaque pointer to xmlsec key data object, declared in <xmlsec/keys.h>. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Identifier (handle) for an xmlsec key data klass/type, declared in <xmlsec/keys.h>. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.

Identifier type for a key store class returned by xmlSecOpenSSLKeysStoreGetKlass(). The actual type is declared elsewhere in the XmlSec headers; this header only references it and provides a function that returns it.
Pointer type to a key store instance used by the OpenSSL keys store API functions in this header. Declared elsewhere; only referenced here.
Pointer type to a key object that can be adopted into the OpenSSL keys store. Declared elsewhere; only referenced here.
Pointer type to a keys manager used when loading keys into the OpenSSL keys store. Declared elsewhere; only referenced here.
Bitmask/enum type indicating key data types for save operations. Declared elsewhere; only referenced here.
Pointer type to xmlsec crypto dynamic loader functions table, declared in included headers. This header only references it via xmlSecCryptoGetFunctions_openssl(). No new definition provided here.
Opaque pointer to an xmlsec keys manager. Referenced as a parameter to xmlSecOpenSSLKeysMngrInit(); not defined in this header.
Opaque pointer to an xmlsec buffer. Referenced as a parameter to xmlSecOpenSSLGenerateRandom(); not defined in this header.

xmlSecKeyDataId is a type (usually typedef/handle) identifying a key data klass in xmlsec. This header defines many macros that evaluate to functions returning xmlSecKeyDataId for specific algorithms (AES, DES, DSA, DH, EC, GOST, HMAC, PBKDF2, RSA). No struct/typedef definition is present here.

xmlSecTransformId is a type (handle) identifying a transform klass in xmlsec. This header defines numerous macros mapping to functions that return specific transform klass identifiers for ciphers, digests, signatures, KDFs, and key agreement. No underlying struct/typedef is defined here.
OpenSSL library context pointer type from OpenSSL 3.0+. Only referenced here via xmlSecOpenSSLSetLibCtx/xmlSecOpenSSLGetLibCtx; not defined in this header.
OpenSSL BIO pointer type. Referenced by helper constructors returning BIO*; not defined in this header.
OpenSSL EVP_PKEY handle. Only referenced as parameter/return type of key adoption/get functions; not defined here.
Opaque pointer to xmlsec key data instance, referenced as parameter to various Set/AdoptEvp functions. Not defined here.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoInit
functions.description: Initializes the XML Security Library cryptographic backend. Call before using any xmlSecCrypto* or crypto-dependent APIs.
requirements: Must be called before any other crypto-dependent xmlsec functions.
Should be paired with a later call to xmlSecCryptoShutdown().
Thread-safety and re-entrancy are unknown; assume process-level initialization.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoShutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the XML Security Library cryptographic backend and releases related resources initialized by xmlSecCryptoInit().
requirements: Should be called after all crypto-dependent operations are finished.
Must be called after a successful xmlSecCryptoInit().
Do not call crypto APIs after shutdown until re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoKeysMngrInit
functions.description: Initializes a keys manager with crypto-specific stores and defaults so it can load/verify keys and certificates.
requirements: mngr must be a valid, allocated xmlSecKeysMngrPtr.
Call xmlSecCryptoInit() before invoking this function.
Do not pass NULL for mngr.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataAesGetKlass

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppInit
functions.description: Initializes high-level crypto application support (used by xmlsec command-line utility). Optional config file/URI may be provided.
requirements: Call xmlSecCryptoInit() before this initializer (inferred by naming and layering).
config may be NULL or a valid path/URI (exact semantics unknown).
Pair with xmlSecCryptoAppShutdown() when done.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppShutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the high-level crypto application support initialized by xmlSecCryptoAppInit().
requirements: Should be called after xmlSecCryptoAppInit().
Do not use xmlSecCryptoApp* helpers after shutdown until re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrInit
functions.description: Initializes a keys manager with default crypto-backed key stores suitable for typical signing/verification and encryption/decryption.
requirements: mngr must be a valid, allocated xmlSecKeysMngrPtr.
Call xmlSecCryptoInit() (and usually xmlSecCryptoAppInit()) before use.
Do not pass NULL for mngr.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrAdoptKey
functions.description: Adds (adopts) a key into a default-initialized keys manager; the manager takes ownership of the key.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager initialized for default use.
key must be a valid xmlSecKeyPtr; after adoption, caller must not destroy the key directly (ownership transfers).
Do not pass NULL for mngr or key.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrVerifyKey
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrVerifyKey(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Verifies a key using the default keys manager context and optional KeyInfo processing context.
requirements: mngr must be a valid default keys manager.
key must be a valid xmlSecKeyPtr.
keyInfoCtx, if provided, must be a valid xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr (may be NULL; exact behavior unknown).

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrLoad
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrLoad(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const char* uri);
functions.description: Loads keys and trusted material into the keys manager from a URI or file path.
requirements: mngr must be a valid default keys manager.
uri must reference a readable source; must not be NULL.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrSave
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppDefaultKeysMngrSave(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const char* filename, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Saves keys from the manager to a file, filtered by key data type flags.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.
filename must be a valid writable path; must not be NULL.
type must be a valid combination of xmlSecKeyDataType flags.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCertLoad
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCertLoad(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const char *filename, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Loads a certificate into the keys manager from a file with the specified encoding and classification (trusted/untrusted, etc.).
requirements: mngr must be valid.
filename must be a readable path; must not be NULL.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.
type must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataType flag set.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCertLoadMemory
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCertLoadMemory(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Loads a certificate into the keys manager from a memory buffer with the specified encoding and classification.
requirements: mngr must be valid.
data must point to a buffer containing the certificate; must not be NULL.
dataSize must match the data length and be > 0.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.
type must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataType flag set.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCrlLoad
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCrlLoad(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const char *filename, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format);
functions.description: Loads a Certificate Revocation List (CRL) into the keys manager from a file.
requirements: mngr must be valid.
filename must be a readable path; must not be NULL.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCrlLoadMemory
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeysMngrCrlLoadMemory(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format);
functions.description: Loads a CRL into the keys manager from a memory buffer.
requirements: mngr must be valid.
data must point to the CRL bytes; must not be NULL.
dataSize must match the buffer length and be > 0.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeyLoadEx
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecCryptoAppKeyLoadEx(const char *filename, xmlSecKeyDataType type, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format, const char *pwd, void* pwdCallback, void* pwdCallbackCtx);
functions.description: Loads a key (and optionally associated data) from a file, specifying expected key type and data format, with optional password or password callback.
requirements: filename must be a readable path; must not be NULL.
type must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataType flag set indicating expected usage/type.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.
pwd may be NULL or a valid password for encrypted key files.
pwdCallback, if non-NULL, must be a function pointer compatible with the library’s password-callback convention; pwdCallbackCtx is passed to it.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeyLoadMemory
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecCryptoAppKeyLoadMemory(const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format, const char *pwd, void* pwdCallback, void* pwdCallbackCtx);
functions.description: Loads a key from a memory buffer with the specified data format and optional password or callback for decryption.
requirements: data must not be NULL and must contain the key serialization.
dataSize must match the buffer length and be > 0.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.
pwd may be NULL or a valid password if needed.
pwdCallback, if provided, must be a compatible password-callback pointer; pwdCallbackCtx is passed through.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppPkcs12Load
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecCryptoAppPkcs12Load(const char* filename, const char* pwd, void* pwdCallback, void* pwdCallbackCtx);
functions.description: Loads a key (and certificates) from a PKCS#12 (PFX) file, using a provided password or callback if necessary.
requirements: filename must be a readable path; must not be NULL.
pwd may be NULL or a valid PKCS#12 password.
pwdCallback, if non-NULL, must be compatible with expected password-callback signature; pwdCallbackCtx is passed through.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppPkcs12LoadMemory
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecCryptoAppPkcs12LoadMemory(const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize, const char *pwd, void* pwdCallback, void* pwdCallbackCtx);
functions.description: Loads a key (and certificates) from a PKCS#12 (PFX) blob in memory, using a provided password or callback if necessary.
requirements: data must not be NULL and must contain the PKCS#12 bytes.
dataSize must match the buffer length and be > 0.
pwd may be NULL or a valid PKCS#12 password.
pwdCallback, if non-NULL, must be a compatible password-callback pointer; pwdCallbackCtx is passed through.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeyCertLoad
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeyCertLoad(xmlSecKeyPtr key, const char* filename, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format);
functions.description: Loads a certificate from file and associates it with a key (e.g., to attach an X.509 cert to a private key).
requirements: key must be a valid xmlSecKeyPtr; must not be NULL.
filename must be a readable path; must not be NULL.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppKeyCertLoadMemory
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecCryptoAppKeyCertLoadMemory(xmlSecKeyPtr key, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize, xmlSecKeyDataFormat format);
functions.description: Loads a certificate from a memory buffer and associates it with a key.
requirements: key must be valid; must not be NULL.
data must not be NULL and must contain the certificate bytes.
dataSize must match the buffer length and be > 0.
format must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataFormat value.

functions.name: xmlSecCryptoAppGetDefaultPwdCallback
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the library’s default password callback function for use with key-loading APIs.
requirements: Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.
Exact callback signature is not declared here; use only with xmlsec password-callback parameters.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxCreate
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new XML Digital Signature processing context (xmlSecDSigCtx) optionally bound to a keys manager. Use for signing or verifying <dsig:Signature/> documents. Destroy with xmlSecDSigCtxDestroy or initialize/finalize with the corresponding APIs if using stack allocation.
requirements: keysMngr may be NULL or a valid, initialized xmlSecKeysMngrPtr (unknown exact requirement; header does not specify).
Caller must check the return value for NULL to detect allocation failure.
Returned context must be destroyed with xmlSecDSigCtxDestroy or finalized with xmlSecDSigCtxFinalize if xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize was used instead.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxDestroy
functions.description: Frees an xmlSecDSigCtx created by xmlSecDSigCtxCreate and releases all associated resources.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a context created by xmlSecDSigCtxCreate or initialized with xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize.
dsigCtx must not be NULL.
Do not use dsigCtx after this call (dangling pointer).
If xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize was used on a stack-allocated context, use xmlSecDSigCtxFinalize instead of xmlSecDSigCtxDestroy.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize
functions.description: Initializes a caller-allocated xmlSecDSigCtx for signing or verification, optionally binding it to a keys manager. Use with xmlSecDSigCtxFinalize to clean up.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid pointer to uninitialized or reset xmlSecDSigCtx storage.
keysMngr may be NULL or a valid, initialized xmlSecKeysMngrPtr (unknown exact requirement; header does not specify).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
On success, caller must later call xmlSecDSigCtxFinalize on the same dsigCtx.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes and cleans up an xmlSecDSigCtx previously initialized with xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid pointer previously initialized with xmlSecDSigCtxInitialize.
Must not be called on a context owned by xmlSecDSigCtxCreate unless taking responsibility to finalize instead of destroy (library convention typically uses Destroy for heap-allocated).
dsigCtx must not be NULL.
Do not use dsigCtx after finalization unless re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxSign
functions.description: Signs the provided XML Signature template node using the settings in dsigCtx, producing a <dsig:Signature/> with computed SignatureValue and reference digests. Use when generating XML Digital Signatures.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx for signing; signKey may be set in dsigCtx prior to calling.
tmpl must be a non-NULL xmlNodePtr pointing to a valid <dsig:Signature/> template node.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
If XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_SIGNATURE flag is set in dsigCtx->flags, the pre-signature buffer will be stored and retrievable via xmlSecDSigCtxGetPreSignBuffer.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxVerify
functions.description: Verifies an existing <dsig:Signature/> node using the configured dsigCtx and available keys. Populates dsigCtx status and failure reason upon completion.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx for verification.
node must be a non-NULL xmlNodePtr to a <dsig:Signature/> element to verify.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
After the call, inspect dsigCtx->status (via xmlSecDSigCtxGetStatusString) and dsigCtx->failureReason for result details.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxEnableReferenceTransform
functions.description: Enables a transform for use inside <dsig:Reference/> processing within this dsigCtx. Use to restrict or allow specific reference transforms.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx.
transformId must be a valid transform identifier corresponding to a reference transform type (e.g., digest or canonicalization used in Reference).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxEnableSignatureTransform
functions.description: Enables a transform for use as the signature method within <dsig:SignedInfo/> for this dsigCtx. Use to allow specific signature algorithms.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx.
transformId must be a valid transform identifier corresponding to a signature method transform.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxGetPreSignBuffer
functions.description: Returns the buffer containing the canonicalized SignedInfo data immediately prior to signature computation, if stored. Useful for debugging or external signature computation.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx.
Pre-sign buffer is available only if XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_SIGNATURE was set before signing; otherwise the return may be NULL.
Caller must not modify or free the returned buffer; it is owned by dsigCtx.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxDebugDump
functions.description: Dumps a human-readable debug representation of dsigCtx to the given FILE stream.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid pointer (may be partially initialized; output may vary).
output must be a valid, writable FILE* (e.g., stdout, stderr, or an open file).
No return value; caller should ensure thread-safe use of FILE if needed.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Dumps an XML-formatted debug representation of dsigCtx to the given FILE stream.
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid pointer.
output must be a valid, writable FILE*.
Produces debug output only; no state changes are made.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxGetStatusString
functions.description: Returns a constant C string describing the xmlSecDSigStatus value (e.g., Unknown, Succeeded, Invalid). Useful for logging and diagnostics.
requirements: status must be a value from xmlSecDSigStatus enum.
Returned pointer is to a static string; caller must not free or modify it.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigCtxGetFailureReasonString
functions.description: Returns a constant C string describing the xmlSecDSigFailureReason value (e.g., Reference, Signature, KeyNotFound). Use after checking overall status.
requirements: failureReason must be a value from xmlSecDSigFailureReason enum.
Returned pointer is to a static string; caller must not free or modify it.
Caller should first check dsigCtx->status to determine operation status before interpreting the failure reason (per documentation note).

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxCreate
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new reference-processing context for a Reference node, associated with a parent dsigCtx and indicating its origin (SignedInfo or Manifest).
requirements: dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx that will parent this reference context.
origin must be a valid xmlSecDSigReferenceOrigin value (xmlSecDSigReferenceOriginSignedInfo or xmlSecDSigReferenceOriginManifest).
Caller must check return value for NULL to detect allocation failure.
The returned context must be destroyed with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxDestroy or finalized after initialization/finalization usage.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxDestroy
functions.description: Frees an xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx created by xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxCreate and releases all associated resources.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must not be NULL.
Do not use dsigRefCtx after this call.
If the context was initialized with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxInitialize on stack storage, use xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxFinalize instead.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxInitialize
functions.signature: int xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxInitialize(xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxPtr dsigRefCtx, xmlSecDSigCtxPtr dsigCtx, xmlSecDSigReferenceOrigin origin);
functions.description: Initializes a caller-allocated xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx for processing a Reference node, binding it to a parent dsigCtx with the specified origin (SignedInfo or Manifest).
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid pointer to uninitialized or reset xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx storage.
dsigCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigCtx that will parent this reference context.
origin must be a valid xmlSecDSigReferenceOrigin value.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
On success, caller must later call xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxFinalize on the same dsigRefCtx.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes and cleans up an xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx previously initialized with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxInitialize.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid pointer previously initialized with xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxInitialize.
dsigRefCtx must not be NULL.
Do not use dsigRefCtx after finalization unless re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxProcessNode
functions.description: Processes a <dsig:Reference/> node: applies the configured transforms, computes/verifies its digest, and updates the reference context status and result buffer.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx.
node must be a non-NULL xmlNodePtr pointing to a <dsig:Reference/> element that matches the origin of the context (SignedInfo or Manifest).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.

If XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_SIGNEDINFO_REFERENCES or XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_MANIFEST_REFERENCES is set in the parent dsigCtx, the pre-digest buffer will be stored and retrievable via xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxGetPreDigestBuffer.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxGetPreDigestBuffer
functions.description: Returns the buffer containing the data just before digest calculation for the processed Reference, if stored. Useful for debugging or external digest verification.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid, initialized xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx.
Pre-digest buffer is available only if XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_SIGNEDINFO_REFERENCES or XMLSEC_DSIG_FLAGS_STORE_MANIFEST_REFERENCES was set in the parent dsigCtx; otherwise the return may be NULL.
Caller must not modify or free the returned buffer; it is owned by the reference context or parent dsigCtx.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxDebugDump
functions.description: Dumps a human-readable debug representation of the reference context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid pointer.
output must be a valid, writable FILE*.
No state changes; intended for diagnostics.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Dumps an XML-formatted debug representation of the reference context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: dsigRefCtx must be a valid pointer.
output must be a valid, writable FILE*.
Produces debug output only; does not modify the context.

functions.name: xmlSecDSigReferenceCtxListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (xmlSecPtrListId) for managing lists of xmlSecDSigReferenceCtx objects. Use with xmlsec list APIs to create/manage reference context lists.
requirements: No arguments.
Returned identifier is used with xmlSecPtrList APIs; caller must not free it.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxCreate
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new XML Encryption context bound to the provided keys manager. Use this to perform encryption/decryption operations; destroy with xmlSecEncCtxDestroy when done.
requirements: keysMngr may be NULL or a valid xmlSecKeysMngrPtr depending on usage; if non-NULL it must remain valid for the lifetime of the created context (inferred from typical xmlsec patterns).
Caller owns the returned context and must free it with xmlSecEncCtxDestroy.
Function may return NULL on allocation or initialization failure (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDestroy
functions.description: Destroys (finalizes and frees) an XML Encryption context previously created by xmlSecEncCtxCreate.
requirements: encCtx must be either NULL or a valid pointer returned by xmlSecEncCtxCreate or successfully initialized with xmlSecEncCtxInitialize.
After calling, encCtx must not be used again.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxInitialize
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxInitialize(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlSecKeysMngrPtr keysMngr);
functions.description: Initializes a caller-provided xmlSecEncCtx structure for use with encryption/decryption operations, optionally associating it with a keys manager. Pair with xmlSecEncCtxFinalize.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, zeroed or non-initialized xmlSecEncCtx storage owned by the caller.
Must be called before using encCtx with other APIs if the context was not created via xmlSecEncCtxCreate.
On success, caller must later call xmlSecEncCtxFinalize to clean up.
Return value indicates success or failure (non-zero indicates error, inferred from xmlsec conventions).
keysMngr, if non-NULL, must remain valid for the lifetime of encCtx or until replaced.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes a context previously initialized with xmlSecEncCtxInitialize, releasing internal resources without freeing the memory block itself.
requirements: encCtx must have been successfully initialized by xmlSecEncCtxInitialize.
Do not call on contexts created by xmlSecEncCtxCreate unless you manage the memory manually; for created contexts prefer xmlSecEncCtxDestroy.
After finalization, encCtx must be re-initialized before reuse.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxCopyUserPref
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxCopyUserPref(xmlSecEncCtxPtr dst, xmlSecEncCtxPtr src);
functions.description: Copies user preferences/settings (flags, default method, key info contexts, etc.) from src context to dst context. Useful to propagate caller-set options.
requirements: dst and src must be valid xmlSecEncCtx pointers; typically both should be initialized.
This does not duplicate runtime results or internal nodes; intended for preferences only (inferred from name).
Return value indicates success or failure (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxReset
functions.description: Resets an encryption context to a clean state for reuse, clearing operation-specific data and results while preserving user preferences.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, initialized context.
All pointers previously returned inside encCtx (e.g., result) should be considered invalid after reset.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxBinaryEncrypt
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxBinaryEncrypt(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlNodePtr tmpl, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize);
functions.description: Encrypts the provided binary buffer according to the <enc:EncryptedData/> template and context settings. On success, may insert/replace nodes in the XML tree and set context result fields.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, initialized context, optionally configured with encKey, defEncMethodId, and flags as needed.
tmpl must be a valid xmlNodePtr pointing to an <enc:EncryptedData/> (or compatible) template node in a libxml2 DOM.
data must point to a buffer of at least dataSize bytes if dataSize > 0; data can be NULL only if dataSize == 0 (inferred).
Function returns an int status; caller must check for failure before using results (inferred).
If XMLSEC_ENC_RETURN_REPLACED_NODE flag is set in encCtx->flags, replaced nodes can be retrieved from encCtx->replacedNodeList (per comments).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxXmlEncrypt
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxXmlEncrypt(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlNodePtr tmpl, xmlNodePtr node);
functions.description: Encrypts an XML node or node-set as specified by the template, producing an <enc:EncryptedData/> element per context configuration. May replace the original node in the document.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, initialized context.
tmpl must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData/> template node.
node must be a valid libxml2 node to be encrypted and typically belong to a document.

Caller must ensure node is in a state suitable for replacement if encCtx->flags request replacement; replaced nodes may be available via encCtx->replacedNodeList when XMLSEC_ENC_RETURN_REPLACED_NODE is set.
Returns status code; caller must check for errors (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxUriEncrypt
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxUriEncrypt(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlNodePtr tmpl, const xmlChar *uri);
functions.description: Encrypts data referenced by the given URI using the provided <enc:EncryptedData/> template and context settings.
requirements: encCtx must be valid and initialized.
tmpl must be a valid template node suitable for encryption.
uri must be a non-NULL, null-terminated xmlChar string identifying the data source (inferred).
Function returns status code; caller must check for errors (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDecrypt
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxDecrypt(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlNodePtr node);
functions.description: Decrypts the specified <enc:EncryptedData/> or <enc:EncryptedKey/> element and processes it according to context settings (e.g., replacing nodes, storing results).
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, initialized context; the application may set encCtx->encKey before calling (per struct comment).
node must point to an <enc:EncryptedData/> or <enc:EncryptedKey/> element in the libxml2 DOM.
On failure, encCtx->failureReason may provide details; caller should consult xmlSecEncCtxGetFailureReasonString for diagnostics.
Returns status code; caller must check for errors before using any output (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDecryptToBuffer
functions.description: Decrypts the given encrypted XML element and returns the result as an xmlSecBufferPtr without modifying the document tree.
requirements: encCtx must be valid and initialized; encCtx->encKey may be set by the application beforehand (per struct comment).
node must be an <enc:EncryptedData/> or compatible encrypted node.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure (inferred).
The returned buffer is owned by the context or the caller depending on implementation; consult library ownership rules when using it (unknown ownership; not specified).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDebugDump
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT void xmlSecEncCtxDebugDump(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, FILE* output);
functions.description: Writes a human-readable debug dump of the encryption context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid (possibly partially initialized) context.
output must be a valid FILE* open for writing.
Intended for debugging; should not be used to parse programmatically.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDebugXmlDump
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT void xmlSecEncCtxDebugXmlDump(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, FILE* output);
functions.description: Writes an XML-formatted debug dump of the encryption context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid context.
output must be a valid FILE* open for writing.
Intended for diagnostics and logging; output format may change between versions (unknown stability).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxDerivedKeyGenerate
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecEncCtxDerivedKeyGenerate(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlSecKeyDataId keyId, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Generates a derived key according to information in the provided XML node (e.g., <enc:DerivedKey/> or method parameters) and returns it as an xmlSecKeyPtr, using encCtx and key info context settings.
requirements: encCtx must be valid and initialized.
keyId must specify the desired key data/class for the resulting key; must be compatible with the derivation method in node (inferred).

keyInfoCtx must be a valid key info context pointer if non-NULL; may influence key resolution and generation (inferred).
Returns NULL on failure; caller is responsible for managing the returned key’s lifetime per xmlsec ownership rules (unknown details).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxAgreementMethodGenerate
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecEncCtxAgreementMethodGenerate(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlSecKeyDataId keyId, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Generates a key using a key agreement method specified by the XML node (e.g., <enc:AgreementMethod/>), producing an xmlSecKeyPtr suitable for subsequent encryption/decryption operations.
requirements: encCtx must be valid and initialized.
keyId must identify the type of key to generate and be compatible with the agreement method (inferred).
node must provide the agreement method parameters in a valid XML structure.
keyInfoCtx, if provided, must be a valid pointer and is used for key handling during generation (inferred).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must free the returned key per xmlsec rules (unknown ownership specifics).

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxAgreementMethodXmlWrite
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecEncCtxAgreementMethodXmlWrite(xmlSecEncCtxPtr encCtx, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Serializes/writes the key agreement method parameters from the context into the provided XML node for inclusion in an XML Encryption structure.
requirements: encCtx must be a valid, initialized context and have sufficient information to serialize an agreement method (inferred).
node must be a valid libxml2 node suitable for holding an <enc:AgreementMethod/> element or parameters.
keyInfoCtx, if provided, must be a valid pointer and is used to control serialization (inferred).
Returns status code; caller must check for errors.

functions.name: xmlSecEncCtxGetFailureReasonString
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the given xmlSecEncFailureReason value for diagnostics and logging.
requirements: failureReason must be a valid xmlSecEncFailureReason enumeration value.
Returned pointer is to a static or library-managed string; caller must not modify or free it (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureCreate
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplSignatureCreate(xmlDocPtr doc, xmlSecTransformId c14nMethodId, xmlSecTransformId signMethodId, const xmlChar *id);
functions.description: Creates a <dsig:Signature> template node in the given libxml2 document with the specified canonicalization and signature methods and an optional Id attribute. Use this to start constructing an XML Signature tree programmatically.
requirements: doc must be a valid, initialized libxml2 document pointer (xmlDocPtr).
c14nMethodId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a canonicalization method.
signMethodId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a signature method.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName for the Id attribute.
Caller must check the return value: NULL indicates failure.
The returned node is owned by the provided libxml2 document; manage lifetime via libxml2.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureCreateNsPref
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplSignatureCreateNsPref(xmlDocPtr doc, xmlSecTransformId c14nMethodId, xmlSecTransformId signMethodId, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *nsPrefix);
functions.description: Creates a <dsig:Signature> template node with the specified namespace prefix, canonicalization method, signature method, and optional Id. Use when you need a specific dsig namespace prefix in the output.

c14nMethodId must be a valid canonicalization transform id.
signMethodId must be a valid signature transform id.
nsPrefix, if non-NULL, should be a valid XML namespace prefix.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
The returned node is owned by the libxml2 document.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureEnsureKeyInfo
functions.description: Ensures that the given <dsig:Signature> node has a <dsig:KeyInfo> child; creates and appends it if absent and optionally sets its Id. Returns the KeyInfo node.
requirements: signNode must be a valid <dsig:Signature> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureAddReference
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplSignatureAddReference(xmlNodePtr signNode, xmlSecTransformId digestMethodId, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *uri, const xmlChar *type);
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Reference> element under <dsig:SignedInfo> of the provided Signature template, setting the digest method and optional Id, URI, and Type. Returns the created Reference node.

digestMethodId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a digest method.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
uri and type, if provided, should be valid XML attribute values/URIs per XML Signature.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureAddObject
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplSignatureAddObject(xmlNodePtr signNode, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *mimeType, const xmlChar *encoding);
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Object> element to the Signature, optionally setting Id, MimeType, and Encoding attributes. Use for embedding additional data or manifests.
requirements: signNode must be a valid <dsig:Signature> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
mimeType and encoding, if provided, should be valid attribute strings.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureGetSignMethodNode
functions.description: Returns the <dsig:SignatureMethod> node from the Signature's SignedInfo section.
requirements: signNode must be a valid <dsig:Signature> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return if the node is missing or on error.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplSignatureGetC14NMethodNode
functions.description: Returns the <dsig:CanonicalizationMethod> node from the Signature's SignedInfo section.
requirements: signNode must be a valid <dsig:Signature> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return if the node is missing or on error.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplReferenceAddTransform
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Transform> child to the given <dsig:Reference> node using the specified transform id. Returns the created Transform node.
requirements: referenceNode must be a valid <dsig:Reference> element node.
transformId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a reference transform.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplObjectAddSignProperties
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplObjectAddSignProperties(xmlNodePtr objectNode, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *target);
functions.description: Adds an <xades:SignedProperties> (or signature properties) structure under a <dsig:Object> node, setting optional Id and Target attributes. Returns the created node.
requirements: objectNode must be a valid <dsig:Object> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
target, if provided, should be a valid URI/attribute value.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplObjectAddManifest
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Manifest> element under the provided <dsig:Object> node with an optional Id. Returns the created Manifest node.
requirements: objectNode must be a valid <dsig:Object> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplManifestAddReference
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplManifestAddReference(xmlNodePtr manifestNode, xmlSecTransformId digestMethodId, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *uri, const xmlChar *type);
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Reference> to a <dsig:Manifest>, configuring the digest method and optional Id, URI, and Type. Returns the created Reference node.
requirements: manifestNode must be a valid <dsig:Manifest> element node.
digestMethodId must be a valid digest xmlSecTransformId.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
uri and type, if provided, should be valid attribute strings.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataCreate
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplEncDataCreate(xmlDocPtr doc, xmlSecTransformId encMethodId, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *type, const xmlChar *mimeType, const xmlChar *encoding);
functions.description: Creates an <enc:EncryptedData> template node in the given document with the specified encryption method and optional Id, Type, MimeType, and Encoding attributes.
requirements: doc must be a valid xmlDocPtr.
encMethodId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for an encryption algorithm.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
type, mimeType, and encoding, if provided, should be valid strings per XML Encryption.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
The returned node is owned by the libxml2 document.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataEnsureKeyInfo
functions.description: Ensures that an <enc:EncryptedData> node has a <dsig:KeyInfo> child; creates it if missing and optionally sets the Id. Returns the KeyInfo node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataEnsureEncProperties
functions.description: Ensures that an <enc:EncryptedData> node has an <enc:EncryptionProperties> child; creates it if missing and optionally sets its Id. Returns the EncryptionProperties node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataAddEncProperty
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplEncDataAddEncProperty(xmlNodePtr encNode, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *target);
functions.description: Adds an <enc:EncryptionProperty> under the <enc:EncryptionProperties> of the given EncryptedData, setting optional Id and Target attributes. Returns the created node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData> element node.
If id is non-NULL, it should be a valid XML NCName.
target, if provided, should be a valid URI/attribute value.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataEnsureCipherValue
functions.description: Ensures that the given EncryptedData has an <enc:CipherValue> element (creating it under <enc:CipherData> if needed). Returns the CipherValue node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData> element node.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataEnsureCipherReference
functions.description: Ensures that the given EncryptedData has an <enc:CipherReference> element with the specified URI (creating it under <enc:CipherData> if needed). Returns the CipherReference node.

uri must be a valid URI string for the CipherReference URI attribute.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplEncDataGetEncMethodNode
functions.description: Returns the <enc:EncryptionMethod> child node of the given EncryptedData, if present.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedData> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return if not present or on error.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplCipherReferenceAddTransform
functions.description: Adds a transform entry under <enc:Transforms> for the given <enc:CipherReference> node using the specified transform id. Returns the created Transform node.
requirements: cipherReferenceNode must be a valid <enc:CipherReference> element node.
transformId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a transform applicable to CipherReference.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplReferenceListAddDataReference
functions.description: Adds a <enc:DataReference> element with the given URI under the <enc:ReferenceList> of an <enc:EncryptedKey> or <enc:EncryptedData>. Returns the created DataReference node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedKey> or <enc:EncryptedData> element node that can contain a ReferenceList.
uri must be a valid URI string.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplReferenceListAddKeyReference
functions.description: Adds a <enc:KeyReference> element with the given URI under the <enc:ReferenceList> of an <enc:EncryptedKey>. Returns the created KeyReference node.
requirements: encNode must be a valid <enc:EncryptedKey> element node that can contain a ReferenceList.
uri must be a valid URI string.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddKeyName
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddKeyName(xmlNodePtr keyInfoNode, const xmlChar* name);
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:KeyName> element with the provided textual name under a <dsig:KeyInfo> node. Returns the created KeyName node.

name must be a valid UTF-8 string; may be subject to XML character constraints.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddKeyValue
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:KeyValue> element to the given KeyInfo to hold public key parameters. Returns the created KeyValue node.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddX509Data
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509Data> element under the given KeyInfo for X.509-related material (certificates, subject names, etc.). Returns the created X509Data node.

Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddRetrievalMethod
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddRetrievalMethod(xmlNodePtr keyInfoNode, const xmlChar *uri, const xmlChar *type);

uri must be a valid URI string.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplRetrievalMethodAddTransform
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:Transform> under a <dsig:RetrievalMethod> node, specifying how to process the retrieved data. Returns the created Transform node.
requirements: retrMethodNode must be a valid <dsig:RetrievalMethod> element node.
transformId must be a valid xmlSecTransformId for a transform applicable to RetrievalMethod.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddEncryptedKey
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplKeyInfoAddEncryptedKey(xmlNodePtr keyInfoNode, xmlSecTransformId encMethodId, const xmlChar *id, const xmlChar *type, const xmlChar *recipient);

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddIssuerSerial
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509IssuerSerial> element under an X509Data node. Returns the created element node.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509IssuerSerialAddIssuerName
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509IssuerName> child with the provided issuer distinguished name text under an X509IssuerSerial element. Returns the created node.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509IssuerSerialAddSerialNumber
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509SerialNumber> child with the provided serial number text under an X509IssuerSerial element. Returns the created node.
