functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddSubjectName
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509SubjectName> element under an X509Data node. Returns the created node (content to be filled by caller).
requirements: x509DataNode must be a valid <dsig:X509Data> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
Caller is responsible for setting the subject name text content if needed.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddSKI
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509SKI> (Subject Key Identifier) element under an X509Data node. Returns the created node.
requirements: x509DataNode must be a valid <dsig:X509Data> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
Caller is responsible for setting the SKI content if needed.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddDigest
functions.signature: xmlNodePtr xmlSecTmplX509DataAddDigest(xmlNodePtr x509DataNode, const xmlChar* digestAlgorithm);
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509Digest> element under an X509Data node, configured to use the specified digest algorithm. Returns the created node.
requirements: x509DataNode must be a valid <dsig:X509Data> element node.
digestAlgorithm must be a valid algorithm identifier/URI for a digest method.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddCertificate
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509Certificate> element under an X509Data node. Returns the created node.
requirements: x509DataNode must be a valid <dsig:X509Data> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
Caller is responsible for providing the base64-encoded certificate content if required.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplX509DataAddCRL
functions.description: Adds a <dsig:X509CRL> element under an X509Data node. Returns the created node.
requirements: x509DataNode must be a valid <dsig:X509Data> element node.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating failure.
Caller is responsible for providing the base64-encoded CRL content if required.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddHmacOutputLength
functions.description: Adds or sets the HMAC output length parameter (in bits) on an HMAC transform node.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node representing an HMAC algorithm.
bitsLen should be a positive number of bits compatible with the chosen HMAC algorithm and XML Signature constraints.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure (per xmlsec conventions).

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddRsaOaepParam
functions.signature: int xmlSecTmplTransformAddRsaOaepParam(xmlNodePtr transformNode, const xmlSecByte *buf, xmlSecSize size);
functions.description: Sets the OAEP parameters (pSource/label) on an RSA-OAEP transform using the provided buffer and size.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node configured for RSA-OAEP.
buf must point to the OAEP parameter bytes; may be NULL only if size is 0 (if supported by implementation).
size must be the length of the buffer in bytes.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddRsaMgf
functions.signature: int xmlSecTmplTransformAddRsaMgf(xmlNodePtr transformNode, const xmlChar* algorithm);
functions.description: Sets the RSA MGF (Mask Generation Function) algorithm URI on an RSA-based transform.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an RSA algorithm supporting MGF parameters.
algorithm must be a valid URI identifying the MGF algorithm.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddRsaDigest
functions.description: Sets the digest algorithm URI used with an RSA transform (e.g., for RSA-PSS).
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an RSA algorithm supporting a digest parameter.
algorithm must be a valid URI identifying the digest algorithm.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddXsltStylesheet
functions.description: Embeds an XSLT stylesheet inside an XSLT transform node using the provided string content.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node configured for an XSLT transform.
xslt must be a valid string representing the XSLT stylesheet content.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddC14NInclNamespaces
functions.description: Sets the InclusiveNamespaces PrefixList on a canonicalization transform that supports inclusive namespaces.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an inclusive C14N algorithm.
prefixList must be a whitespace-separated list of XML namespace prefixes.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPath
functions.signature: int xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPath(xmlNodePtr transformNode, const xmlChar *expression, const xmlChar **nsList);
functions.description: Adds an XPath transform specification with the given expression and optional namespace prefix mapping list to a transform node.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an XPath transform.
expression must be a valid XPath expression string.
nsList, if provided, should be a NULL-terminated array of prefix/namespace URI pairs as expected by xmlsec/libxml2.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPath2
functions.signature: int xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPath2(xmlNodePtr transformNode, const xmlChar* type, const xmlChar *expression, const xmlChar **nsList);
functions.description: Adds an XPath Filter 2.0 (XPath2) transform specification with the given filter type, expression, and optional namespace mappings to a transform node.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an XPath2 transform.
type must be a valid XPath2 filter type string (e.g., intersect, subtract, union) as defined by XMLDSig XPath Filter 2.0.
expression must be a valid XPath expression string.
nsList, if provided, should be a NULL-terminated array of prefix/namespace URI pairs.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPointer
functions.signature: int xmlSecTmplTransformAddXPointer(xmlNodePtr transformNode, const xmlChar *expression, const xmlChar **nsList);
functions.description: Adds an XPointer transform specification with the given expression and optional namespace mappings to a transform node.
requirements: transformNode must be a valid <dsig:Transform> element node for an XPointer transform.
expression must be a valid XPointer expression string.
nsList, if provided, should be a NULL-terminated array of prefix/namespace URI pairs.
Caller must check the return value: 0 indicates success; a negative value indicates failure.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoNodeRead
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecKeyInfoNodeRead(xmlNodePtr keyInfoNode, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Parses a <dsig:KeyInfo/> XML node and loads key material or key references into the provided xmlSecKey using the settings in keyInfoCtx. Typical usage: prepare/initialize keyInfoCtx for reading (mode = xmlSecKeyInfoModeRead, flags, keys manager, etc.), then call this function with the <KeyInfo> node and a target key object.
requirements: keyInfoNode must point to a <dsig:KeyInfo/> element node (not null).
key must be a valid, initialized xmlSecKeyPtr suitable to receive data.
keyInfoCtx must be a valid, initialized context configured for reading (ctx->mode == xmlSecKeyInfoModeRead).
Caller should set ctx flags (e.g., XMLSEC_KEYINFO_FLAGS_*) and managers prior to calling, if needed.
Returns an int status (typically 0 on success, negative on failure); caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoNodeWrite
functions.signature: XMLSEC_EXPORT int xmlSecKeyInfoNodeWrite(xmlNodePtr keyInfoNode, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Serializes key information from the provided xmlSecKey into the given <dsig:KeyInfo/> XML node according to keyInfoCtx settings. Typical usage: prepare/initialize keyInfoCtx for writing (mode = xmlSecKeyInfoModeWrite), then call with a <KeyInfo> node to populate.
requirements: keyInfoNode must point to a <dsig:KeyInfo/> element node (not null) that is part of a libxml2 document.
key must be a valid, initialized xmlSecKeyPtr containing data to serialize.
keyInfoCtx must be a valid, initialized context configured for writing (ctx->mode == xmlSecKeyInfoModeWrite).
Caller should configure enabled key data list, base64 line size, and flags as needed before calling.
Returns an int status (typically 0 on success, negative on failure); caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxCreate
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new xmlSecKeyInfoCtx for reading or writing <dsig:KeyInfo/> elements, optionally associating it with a keys manager.
requirements: keysMngr must be a valid xmlSecKeysMngrPtr if non-null; ownership is not transferred unless documented elsewhere (unknown).
On success returns a non-null context pointer; on error returns NULL; caller must check the return value.
Caller must destroy the returned context with xmlSecKeyInfoCtxDestroy to avoid leaks.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxDestroy
functions.description: Destroys and frees an xmlSecKeyInfoCtx created by xmlSecKeyInfoCtxCreate, releasing associated resources.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must be a context previously created by xmlSecKeyInfoCtxCreate or successfully initialized and not yet destroyed.
After this call, keyInfoCtx must not be used.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxInitialize
functions.description: Initializes a caller-allocated xmlSecKeyInfoCtx structure for KeyInfo processing, optionally binding it to a keys manager.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must point to valid storage for a context (typically zeroed or uninitialized memory allocated by the caller).
keysMngr must be a valid xmlSecKeysMngrPtr if non-null (ownership semantics unknown).
Returns an int status (typically 0 on success, negative on failure); caller must check the return value.
On success, the context must be finalized with xmlSecKeyInfoCtxFinalize before the storage is freed or re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes an initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtx, releasing internal resources but not freeing the storage itself (for stack/static allocations).
requirements: keyInfoCtx must have been successfully initialized with xmlSecKeyInfoCtxInitialize.
Do not call xmlSecKeyInfoCtxFinalize on a context already destroyed or not initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxReset
functions.description: Resets an initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtx to its default state, clearing transient state while keeping the context usable for another operation.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must be a valid, initialized context.
Any in-progress processing using this context should be completed or aborted before resetting (implied by reset semantics).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxCopyUserPref
functions.description: Copies user-configurable preferences (e.g., flags, enabled data, limits) from src context to dst without copying internal transient processing state.
requirements: dst must be a valid, initialized context ready to receive user preferences.
src must be a valid, initialized context providing preferences.
Returns an int status (typically 0 on success, negative on failure); caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxCreateEncCtx
functions.description: Creates and attaches an internal xmlenc encryption context (encCtx) inside the given KeyInfo context for handling <enc:EncryptedKey/> or related processing.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must be a valid, initialized context.
Available only when XML Encryption support is enabled at build time (XMLSEC_NO_XMLENC not defined); otherwise the call may fail.
Returns an int status (typically 0 on success, negative on failure); caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxDebugDump
functions.description: Writes a human-readable debug dump of the key info context state to the given FILE stream.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must be a valid (preferably initialized) context.
output must be a valid, writable FILE* stream (non-null).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyInfoCtxDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Writes an XML-formatted debug dump of the key info context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: keyInfoCtx must be a valid (preferably initialized) context.
output must be a valid, writable FILE* stream (non-null).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataNameGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <dsig:KeyName/> elements in <dsig:KeyInfo/>.
requirements: Return value must be registered/enabled with the keys manager or context as required by the application before use (typical xmlsec pattern).
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataValueGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <dsig:KeyValue/> elements in <dsig:KeyInfo/>.
requirements: Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataRetrievalMethodGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <dsig:RetrievalMethod/> elements in <dsig:KeyInfo/>.
requirements: Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataKeyInfoReferenceGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <dsig11:KeyInfoReference/> elements in <dsig:KeyInfo/>.
requirements: Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataEncryptedKeyGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <enc:EncryptedKey/> elements. Availability depends on XML Encryption support.
requirements: Available only if built with XML Encryption enabled (XMLSEC_NO_XMLENC not defined).
Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataAgreementMethodGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <enc:AgreementMethod/> elements. Availability depends on XML Encryption support.
requirements: Available only if built with XML Encryption enabled (XMLSEC_NO_XMLENC not defined).
Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataDerivedKeyGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the xmlSecKeyDataId class for processing <enc11:DerivedKey/> elements. Availability depends on XML Encryption support.
requirements: Available only if built with XML Encryption enabled (XMLSEC_NO_XMLENC not defined).
Caller should ensure the returned id is registered/enabled as needed by the application.
Caller must check that the returned id is non-null before using.

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrCreate
functions.description: Creates and returns a new keys manager instance used to manage key stores and retrieve keys. Typical usage: create a manager, attach key/data stores, then use it to find keys.
requirements: Caller must destroy the returned manager with xmlSecKeysMngrDestroy when no longer needed.
Returns NULL on failure (inferred from library conventions for pointer-returning constructors).

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrDestroy
functions.description: Destroys a keys manager and releases its resources, including any adopted stores.
requirements: mngr must be a valid xmlSecKeysMngrPtr previously created by xmlSecKeysMngrCreate or otherwise properly initialized.
Do not use mngr after calling this function.

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrFindKey
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeysMngrFindKey(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, const xmlChar* name, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Searches for and returns a key from the manager, using an optional key name and the provided KeyInfo processing context. Returns the found key or NULL if not found or on error. Ownership semantics of the returned key are not specified in this header (unknown; consult library docs).
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager with appropriate stores configured.
keyInfoCtx must be a properly initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr.
name may be NULL or a pointer to a key name (exact requirements not stated; unknown).

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrFindKeyFromX509Data
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeysMngrFindKeyFromX509Data(xmlSecKeysMngrPtr mngr, xmlSecKeyX509DataValuePtr x509Data, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Searches for and returns a key from the manager by matching provided X.509 data. Returns the key or NULL if not found or on error. Ownership semantics of the returned key are not specified here (unknown).
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.
x509Data must point to initialized X.509 data used for lookup.
keyInfoCtx must be a properly initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr.

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrAdoptKeysStore
functions.description: Attaches (adopts) a key store to the keys manager. On success, the manager owns the store.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.
store must be a valid xmlSecKeyStorePtr.
On success, ownership of store is transferred to mngr (caller must not destroy store afterwards).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error (inferred from library conventions for int-returning functions).

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrGetKeysStore
functions.description: Returns the primary keys store associated with the keys manager, or NULL if none or on error.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrAdoptDataStore
functions.description: Attaches (adopts) a key data store to the keys manager. On success, the manager owns the data store.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.
store must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataStorePtr.
On success, ownership of store is transferred to mngr (caller must not destroy store afterwards).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error (inferred from library conventions).

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrGetDataStore
functions.description: Retrieves a data store from the manager by its store id (klass). Returns the data store pointer or NULL if not present or on error.
requirements: mngr must be a valid keys manager.
id must be a valid xmlSecKeyDataStoreId identifying the desired data store.

functions.name: xmlSecKeysMngrGetKey
functions.description: Parses a <dsig:KeyInfo/> node and extracts a key using the provided KeyInfo processing context. Returns the key pointer or NULL if the key is not found or an error occurs.
requirements: keyInfoNode must point to a valid <dsig:KeyInfo/> XML node.
keyInfoCtx must be a properly initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr used for KeyInfo processing.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyStoreCreate
functions.description: Creates a key store instance for the specified store klass id and returns it, or NULL on error.
requirements: id must be a valid xmlSecKeyStoreId (klass) describing the store implementation.
Caller must destroy the returned store with xmlSecKeyStoreDestroy on success.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyStoreDestroy
functions.description: Finalizes and frees a key store created by xmlSecKeyStoreCreate (or otherwise properly initialized).
requirements: store must be a valid xmlSecKeyStorePtr.
Do not use store after this call.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyStoreFindKey
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyStoreFindKey(xmlSecKeyStorePtr store, const xmlChar* name, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Finds and returns a key from the store by name using the provided KeyInfo context. The store-specific documentation indicates the caller is responsible for destroying the returned key using xmlSecKeyDestroy.
requirements: store must be a valid key store.
keyInfoCtx must be a properly initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr.
If a key is returned, caller is responsible for destroying it with xmlSecKeyDestroy (per store find method contract).
name may be NULL or a key name (exact constraints not specified; unknown).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyStoreFindKeyFromX509Data
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyStoreFindKeyFromX509Data(xmlSecKeyStorePtr store, xmlSecKeyX509DataValuePtr x509Data, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Finds and returns a key from the store based on provided X.509 data and KeyInfo context. Per contract, the caller is responsible for destroying the returned key using xmlSecKeyDestroy.
requirements: store must be a valid key store.
x509Data must be initialized X.509 data used for lookup.
keyInfoCtx must be a properly initialized xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr.
If a key is returned, caller must destroy it with xmlSecKeyDestroy.

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the klass (id) for the built-in Simple Keys Store implementation. Use with xmlSecKeyStoreCreate or for id checks.
requirements: None specific; returns a valid xmlSecKeyStoreId for the simple keys store.

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreAdoptKey
functions.description: Adds a key to a Simple Keys Store. On success, the store takes ownership of the key. Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error.
requirements: store must be an instance of the Simple Keys Store (i.e., created with xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreGetKlass).
key must be a valid xmlSecKeyPtr.
On success, caller must not destroy key (ownership transferred to store).

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreLoad
functions.signature: int xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreLoad(xmlSecKeyStorePtr store, const char *uri, xmlSecKeysMngrPtr keysMngr);
functions.description: Loads keys into a Simple Keys Store from the specified URI, optionally using a keys manager during loading. Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error (inferred from library conventions).
requirements: store must be an instance of the Simple Keys Store.
uri must reference a location containing keys in a format supported by the library (exact formats not specified here; unknown).
keysMngr must be a valid keys manager if provided (usage specifics not documented here; unknown).

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreLoad_ex
functions.signature: int xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreLoad_ex(xmlSecKeyStorePtr store, const char *uri, xmlSecKeysMngrPtr keysMngr, xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreAdoptKeyFunc adoptKeyFunc);
functions.description: Extended load for Simple Keys Store that reads keys from the given URI and uses the provided adoptKeyFunc callback to add keys to the store. Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error (by convention).
requirements: store must be an instance of the Simple Keys Store.
uri must reference a readable key source (exact formats not specified; unknown).
keysMngr must be a valid keys manager if used by the implementation.
adoptKeyFunc must be a valid callback; it will be called to adopt each loaded key and should return 0 on success (per callback contract).

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreSave
functions.signature: int xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreSave(xmlSecKeyStorePtr store, const char *filename, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Saves keys from a Simple Keys Store into a file, filtering by the specified key data type. Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error (by convention).
requirements: store must be an instance of the Simple Keys Store.
filename must be a valid path to a writable file.
type specifies which key data types to save (exact semantics depend on xmlSecKeyDataType; not detailed here).

functions.name: xmlSecSimpleKeysStoreGetKeys
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal list of keys in a Simple Keys Store, or NULL on error. Primarily for direct access or iteration.
requirements: store must be an instance of the Simple Keys Store.
Returned list pointer must be treated according to library rules for xmlSecPtrList (modification and ownership semantics are not specified here; unknown).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsGet
functions.description: Returns the global list of registered key data ids (all known key data classes). Intended for querying/iteration over available key data implementations.
requirements: Must be called in a context where the xmlsec library is initialized; calling after xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit() is recommended (inferred from naming).
Return value should be checked for NULL to detect errors.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsGetEnabled
functions.description: Returns the list of currently enabled key data ids. Useful for determining which key data classes are active for operations.
requirements: Should be called after library/key-data ids initialization (inferred).
Caller must check the return value for NULL.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit
functions.description: Initializes the global key data ids subsystem. Typically called once during library setup before using key data ids.
requirements: Should be called before registering or querying key data ids (inferred).
Return value 0 indicates success; negative value indicates error; caller must handle errors.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsShutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the global key data ids subsystem and releases related resources. Typically called during library shutdown.
requirements: Should be called after xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit() and when no further key data ids operations are needed (inferred).
Must not be called while other threads are using the ids list (inferred from typical global shutdown semantics).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsRegisterDefault
functions.description: Registers the library’s default key data ids (built-in implementations) in the global registry.
requirements: Should be called after xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit() (inferred).
Return value 0 indicates success; negative value indicates error.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsRegister
functions.description: Registers a key data id (class) in the global registry so it can be used by the library.
requirements: Parameter id must not be NULL.
Should be called after xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit() (inferred).
Return value 0 indicates success; negative value indicates error; caller must handle errors.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdsRegisterDisabled
functions.description: Registers a key data id in the global registry in a disabled state (not active for operations until enabled elsewhere).
requirements: Parameter id must not be NULL.
Should be called after xmlSecKeyDataIdsInit() (inferred).
Return value 0 indicates success; negative value indicates error.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataCreate
functions.description: Creates a new key data object of the given class id.
requirements: Parameter id must not be NULL.
Caller must check the return value for NULL and destroy the object with xmlSecKeyDataDestroy() when no longer needed (inferred from create/destroy pattern).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataDuplicate
functions.description: Creates a duplicate (copy) of the given key data object using the class’s duplicate method.
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object (non-NULL and initialized).
Caller must check the return value for NULL and destroy the returned object with xmlSecKeyDataDestroy() when done (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataDestroy
functions.description: Destroys a key data object and frees all resources allocated by it.
requirements: Parameter data may be NULL or must refer to a valid key data object; destroying the same object more than once is invalid (inferred).
After this call, the pointer must not be used again.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataGenerate
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataGenerate(xmlSecKeyDataPtr data, xmlSecSize sizeBits, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Generates key material into the key data object according to the requested size and key type (e.g., session/permanent, public/private/symmetric).
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object.
sizeBits specifies the desired key size in bits; must be appropriate for the underlying key type (inferred).
type indicates required key type; must be compatible with the key data class.
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error; caller must handle errors.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataGetType
functions.description: Returns the key type flags for the key data (e.g., public/private/symmetric, session/permanent, trusted).
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object.
Caller must handle and interpret the returned bitmask.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataGetSize
functions.description: Returns the key size in bits for the key data object.
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object.
Caller must verify the returned size is suitable for its use.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataDebugDump
functions.description: Prints debug information about the key data to a FILE stream.
requirements: Parameter data should be a valid key data object.
Parameter output must be a valid FILE* opened for writing (explicitly stated).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Prints debug information about the key data in XML format to a FILE stream.
requirements: Parameter data should be a valid key data object.
Parameter output must be a valid FILE* opened for writing (explicitly stated).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataXmlRead
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataXmlRead(xmlSecKeyDataId id, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Reads key data from an XML node and attaches/imports it into the provided key according to the key data class id.
requirements: id must refer to a valid key data class.
key must be a valid key object ready to receive the data (inferred).
node must point to the data’s value XML node (explicitly stated).
keyInfoCtx is the KeyInfo node processing context; must be properly initialized for the operation (inferred).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error; caller must handle errors.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataXmlWrite
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataXmlWrite(xmlSecKeyDataId id, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Writes key data to an XML node using the specified key data class id and KeyInfo processing context.
requirements: id must refer to a valid key data class.
key must be a valid key object containing data to write (inferred).
node must point to the data’s value XML node (explicitly stated).
keyInfoCtx is the KeyInfo node processing context; must be properly initialized (inferred).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataBinRead
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataBinRead(xmlSecKeyDataId id, xmlSecKeyPtr key, const xmlSecByte* buf, xmlSecSize bufSize, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Reads key data from a binary buffer and attaches/imports it into the provided key according to the key data class id.
requirements: id must refer to a valid key data class.
key must be a valid key object (inferred).
buf must point to input buffer containing the key data; must not be NULL (inferred).
bufSize is the size of the input buffer in bytes; must match the content of buf (inferred).
keyInfoCtx is the KeyInfo processing context; must be initialized (inferred).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataBinWrite
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataBinWrite(xmlSecKeyDataId id, xmlSecKeyPtr key, xmlSecByte** buf, xmlSecSize* bufSize, xmlSecKeyInfoCtxPtr keyInfoCtx);
functions.description: Writes/exports key data to a binary buffer according to the key data class id.
requirements: id must refer to a valid key data class.
key must be a valid key object containing data to export (inferred).
buf must be a non-NULL output pointer to receive the buffer (inferred).
bufSize must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the buffer size in bytes (inferred).
keyInfoCtx is the KeyInfo processing context; must be initialized (inferred).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error. Ownership/allocation details of the output buffer are not stated; caller should consult implementation/documentation.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataBinaryValueGetSize
functions.description: Helper for binary key data classes: returns the size in bytes of the internal binary value contained in the key data.
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object representing binary key data (inferred from function group).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataBinaryValueGetBuffer
functions.description: Helper for binary key data classes: returns a pointer to the internal xmlSecBuffer that stores the binary key value.
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object representing binary key data (inferred).
Caller must not modify the buffer in a way that breaks the key data invariants; ownership/constness is not specified.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataBinaryValueSetBuffer
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyDataBinaryValueSetBuffer(xmlSecKeyDataPtr data, const xmlSecByte* buf, xmlSecSize bufSize);
functions.description: Helper for binary key data classes: replaces/sets the internal binary value from the provided buffer and size.
requirements: Parameter data must be a valid key data object representing binary key data (inferred).
buf may be NULL only if supported by the implementation; otherwise must be non-NULL (inferred).
bufSize must reflect the size of buf in bytes; large enough for the intended key material (inferred).
Returns 0 on success or a negative value on error.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (klass id) for lists of key data objects.
requirements: Caller uses the returned id to initialize/manage xmlSecPtrList instances (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (klass id) for lists of key data ids (classes).
requirements: Caller uses the returned id to initialize/manage xmlSecPtrList instances (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListFind
functions.description: Searches the list for the given key data id and returns its index or a negative value if not found/error.
requirements: list must be a valid pointer to a list of key data ids (inferred).
dataId must be a valid key data id.
Caller must check the returned integer for negative values indicating not found or error (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByNode
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyDataId xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByNode(xmlSecPtrListPtr list, const xmlChar* nodeName, const xmlChar* nodeNs, xmlSecKeyDataUsage usage);
functions.description: Finds a key data id in the list that matches the given XML node name/namespace and allowed usage flags.
requirements: list must be a valid pointer to a list of key data ids.
nodeName must be the data’s XML node name; may be NULL only if supported (not stated).
nodeNs must be the data’s XML node namespace; may be NULL only if supported (not stated).
usage is a bitmask filter; caller should pass appropriate flags (e.g., xmlSecKeyDataUsageKeyInfoNodeRead, etc.).
Caller must check the return value for NULL when not found or on error (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByHref
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyDataId xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByHref(xmlSecPtrListPtr list, const xmlChar* href, xmlSecKeyDataUsage usage);
functions.description: Finds a key data id in the list that matches the given identification string (href) and allowed usage flags.
requirements: list must be a valid pointer to a list of key data ids.
href must point to the identification string to match; may be NULL only if supported (not stated).
usage is a bitmask filter; caller should pass appropriate flags.
Caller must check the return value for NULL (not found or error).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByName
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyDataId xmlSecKeyDataIdListFindByName(xmlSecPtrListPtr list, const xmlChar* name, xmlSecKeyDataUsage usage);
functions.description: Finds a key data id in the list by its class name and allowed usage flags.
requirements: list must be a valid pointer to a list of key data ids.
name must be the class name string; may be NULL only if supported (not stated).
usage is a bitmask filter; caller should pass appropriate flags.
Caller must check the return value for NULL (not found or error).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListDebugDump
functions.description: Prints debug information about the key data id list to a FILE stream.
requirements: list should be a valid list pointer.
output must be a FILE* opened for writing (inferred from similar debug API).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataIdListDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Prints debug information about the key data id list in XML format to a FILE stream.
requirements: list should be a valid list pointer.
output must be a FILE* opened for writing (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataStoreCreate
functions.description: Creates a new key data store object of the given store class id.
requirements: id must not be NULL.
Caller must check the return value for NULL and destroy the store with xmlSecKeyDataStoreDestroy() when done (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataStoreDestroy
functions.description: Destroys a key data store object and frees all associated resources.
requirements: store must be a valid key data store pointer; calling destroy more than once is invalid (inferred).
After destruction, the pointer must not be used.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataStorePtrListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (klass id) for lists of key data store pointers.
requirements: Caller uses the returned id to initialize/manage xmlSecPtrList instances (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecImportSetPersistKey
functions.description: Configures key import behavior to persist imported keys. Exact semantics are not described in this header.
requirements: No parameters. Effect and scope are unspecified in this header; consult library documentation for details.
Assumed to be called before key import operations to affect behavior (inferred from name).

functions.name: xmlSecImportGetPersistKey
functions.description: Returns the current setting controlling whether imported keys are persisted. Exact semantics are not described here.
requirements: Caller must interpret the returned integer; nonzero typically means enabled (inferred).

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDataGetIdentifier
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Returns a string identifier for the key data. This API is marked deprecated in the header and may be removed in future versions.
requirements: Parameter data should be a valid key data object.
Callers should avoid using this function in new code due to deprecation.

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithInitialize
functions.description: Initializes an xmlSecKeyUseWith structure for use (sets it to a valid, empty state). Call before using other xmlSecKeyUseWith API on a stack/embedded instance.
requirements: keyUseWith must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to allocated storage for xmlSecKeyUseWith
Must be called before xmlSecKeyUseWithFinalize on the same instance
Do not call twice without a Reset/Finalize in between

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes an xmlSecKeyUseWith structure, releasing any resources it holds. Use for stack/embedded instances to clean up after Initialize.
requirements: keyUseWith must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized xmlSecKeyUseWith
After this call, the object must not be used unless re-initialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithReset
functions.description: Resets the xmlSecKeyUseWith structure to an empty state, clearing application/identifier data while keeping the instance initialized.
requirements: keyUseWith must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to an initialized xmlSecKeyUseWith

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithCopy
functions.description: Copies the application/identifier info from src to dst.
requirements: dst and src must be non-NULL
src must be an initialized xmlSecKeyUseWith
dst must be an initialized xmlSecKeyUseWith
On failure, dst’s previous contents may be unchanged or partial; caller should handle error return

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithCreate
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyUseWithPtr xmlSecKeyUseWithCreate(const xmlChar* application, const xmlChar* identifier);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new xmlSecKeyUseWith object initialized with the given application and identifier strings.
requirements: application may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string (exact allowance is unknown)
identifier may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string (exact allowance is unknown)
Returned pointer must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyUseWithDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithDuplicate
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of the provided xmlSecKeyUseWith and returns a new allocated instance.
requirements: keyUseWith must be non-NULL and initialized
Returned pointer must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyUseWithDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithDestroy
functions.description: Destroys a heap-allocated xmlSecKeyUseWith object and frees its resources. Use on objects returned by xmlSecKeyUseWithCreate or xmlSecKeyUseWithDuplicate.
requirements: keyUseWith must be either NULL or a pointer previously returned by xmlSecKeyUseWithCreate/xmlSecKeyUseWithDuplicate (or otherwise heap-allocated per library contract)
After this call, the pointer must not be used

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithSet
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyUseWithSet(xmlSecKeyUseWithPtr keyUseWith, const xmlChar* application, const xmlChar* identifier);
functions.description: Sets or updates the application and identifier fields for an initialized xmlSecKeyUseWith.
requirements: keyUseWith must be non-NULL and initialized
application may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string (exact allowance is unknown)
identifier may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string (exact allowance is unknown)

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithDebugDump
functions.description: Writes a human-readable debug dump of xmlSecKeyUseWith to the given FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
keyUseWith should be initialized; behavior is unknown for NULL or uninitialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Writes an XML-formatted debug dump of xmlSecKeyUseWith to the given FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
keyUseWith should be initialized; behavior is unknown for NULL or uninitialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyUseWithPtrListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (klass) descriptor for lists of xmlSecKeyUseWithPtr elements, for use with the xmlSecPtrList API.
requirements: No arguments
Return value must be used only with compatible xmlSecPtrList operations

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqInitialize
functions.description: Initializes an xmlSecKeyReq structure to hold key requirement parameters.
requirements: keyReq must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to allocated storage for xmlSecKeyReq
Must be called before other xmlSecKeyReq APIs on a stack/embedded instance
Do not call twice without Reset/Finalize in between

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes an xmlSecKeyReq structure, releasing any resources it holds (including its keyUseWithList).
requirements: keyReq must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized xmlSecKeyReq
After this call, the object must not be used unless re-initialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqReset
functions.description: Resets the xmlSecKeyReq to its default/empty state, clearing any previously set requirements while keeping it initialized.
requirements: keyReq must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to an initialized xmlSecKeyReq

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqCopy
functions.description: Copies key requirement parameters from src to dst.
requirements: dst and src must be non-NULL
src must be an initialized xmlSecKeyReq
dst must be an initialized xmlSecKeyReq
On failure, dst’s contents may be unchanged or partial; handle error return

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqMatchKey
functions.description: Checks whether the given key satisfies the requirements specified in keyReq (type, usage, size, use-with, etc.).
requirements: keyReq must be non-NULL and initialized
key must be non-NULL and a valid key (see xmlSecKeyIsValid macro)
Return is an int status (non-zero typically indicates match); exact convention is library-defined

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqMatchKeyValue
functions.description: Checks whether the given key value (xmlSecKeyData) satisfies the requirements specified in keyReq.
requirements: keyReq must be non-NULL and initialized
value must be non-NULL and a valid key value object (id set)
Return is an int status (match/non-match as per library)

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqDebugDump
functions.description: Writes a human-readable debug dump of the key requirements to the FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
keyReq should be initialized; behavior is unknown for NULL or uninitialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReqDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Writes an XML-formatted debug dump of the key requirements to the FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
keyReq should be initialized; behavior is unknown for NULL or uninitialized

functions.name: xmlSecKeyCreate
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new, empty xmlSecKey object.
requirements: Returned key must be freed with xmlSecKeyDestroy
Key is empty until a value or data is set/adopted

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDestroy
functions.description: Destroys a key created by xmlSecKeyCreate (or similar), releasing all associated resources.
requirements: key may be NULL (a no-op) or a pointer returned by xmlSecKeyCreate/duplicate/generate/read functions
After this call, the key pointer must not be used

functions.name: xmlSecKeyEmpty
functions.description: Removes and frees all data from the key, leaving it in an empty but valid state.
requirements: key must be non-NULL and a valid key object

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDuplicate
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the given key.
requirements: key must be non-NULL and valid (see xmlSecKeyIsValid)
Returned key must be freed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyCopy
functions.description: Copies the contents of keySrc into keyDst, replacing any existing data in keyDst.
requirements: keyDst and keySrc must be non-NULL
keySrc should be a valid key (see xmlSecKeyIsValid for value-related checks)
keyDst must be an allocated key object (e.g., from xmlSecKeyCreate)
On failure, keyDst contents may be unchanged or partial; handle error return

functions.name: xmlSecKeySwap
functions.description: Swaps the contents of two keys.
requirements: key1 and key2 must be non-NULL key objects
Keys should be allocated/initialized before swapping

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGetName
functions.description: Returns the key’s name, or NULL if no name is set.
requirements: key must be non-NULL

functions.name: xmlSecKeySetName
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeySetName(xmlSecKeyPtr key, const xmlChar* name);
functions.description: Sets the key’s name to the given UTF-8 xmlChar string.
requirements: key must be non-NULL
name may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string (exact allowance is unknown)

functions.name: xmlSecKeySetNameEx
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeySetNameEx(xmlSecKeyPtr key, const xmlChar* name, xmlSecSize nameSize);
functions.description: Sets the key’s name from a buffer with explicit length.
requirements: key must be non-NULL
name must point to a buffer of at least nameSize bytes (may or may not be null-terminated; exact handling is unknown)
nameSize is the number of bytes to use from name; valid range is implementation-defined (must not overflow internal limits)

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGetType
functions.description: Returns the key’s data type flags (e.g., public/private, session/permanent), derived from the current value.
requirements: key must be non-NULL

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGetValue
functions.description: Returns the key value object (xmlSecKeyData) held by the key, or NULL if none is set.
requirements: key must be non-NULL

functions.name: xmlSecKeySetValue
functions.description: Sets the key’s main value (xmlSecKeyData).
requirements: key must be non-NULL
value must be a non-NULL, properly constructed xmlSecKeyData with a valid id
Ownership/transfer semantics are unspecified in this header (unknown); callers should follow library documentation

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGetSize
functions.description: Returns the key size in bits for the main key value, or 0 if unknown/not set.
requirements: key must be non-NULL

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGetData
functions.description: Returns a pointer to auxiliary key data of the specified type (dataId) attached to the key, or NULL if not present.
requirements: key must be non-NULL
dataId must be a valid key data class identifier

functions.name: xmlSecKeyEnsureData
functions.description: Ensures that auxiliary key data of the specified type is present on the key; creates/attaches it if missing and returns it.
requirements: key must be non-NULL
dataId must be a valid key data class identifier
May allocate memory; caller should check for NULL return on failure

functions.name: xmlSecKeyAdoptData
functions.description: Attaches the provided auxiliary key data object to the key (adopts it).
requirements: key must be non-NULL
data must be a non-NULL xmlSecKeyData whose type matches what the key can accept
Ownership is transferred to the key (inferred from “Adopt” naming); caller must not free data after successful adoption

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDebugDump
functions.description: Writes a human-readable debug dump of the key (name, type, usage, validity, etc.) to the FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
key should be non-NULL; behavior for NULL is unspecified

functions.name: xmlSecKeyDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Writes an XML-formatted debug dump of the key to the FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid, open FILE* for writing
key should be non-NULL; behavior for NULL is unspecified

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGenerate
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyGenerate(xmlSecKeyDataId dataId, xmlSecSize sizeBits, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Generates a new key of the specified class (dataId), size (in bits), and type (usage/flags), and returns it.
requirements: dataId must identify a key data class that supports key generation
sizeBits must be a valid size for the chosen dataId (algorithm); exact ranges are implementation-defined
type must be a valid combination of xmlSecKeyDataType flags for the algorithm
Returned key must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyGenerateByName
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyGenerateByName(const xmlChar* name, xmlSecSize sizeBits, xmlSecKeyDataType type);
functions.description: Generates a new key by the algorithm name, with the given size (bits) and type flags.
requirements: name must be a non-NULL, null-terminated xmlChar string identifying a supported key type
sizeBits must be valid for the named algorithm; exact ranges are implementation-defined
type must be a valid combination of xmlSecKeyDataType flags for the algorithm
Returned key must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyMatch
functions.signature: int xmlSecKeyMatch(xmlSecKeyPtr key, const xmlChar *name, xmlSecKeyReqPtr keyReq);
functions.description: Checks whether the key matches the optional name and satisfies the given key requirements.
requirements: key must be non-NULL and preferably valid (see xmlSecKeyIsValid)
name may be NULL or a null-terminated xmlChar string to check against the key name
keyReq may be NULL (to only check name) or an initialized xmlSecKeyReq
Returns match status as int; exact convention is library-defined

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReadBuffer
functions.description: Parses a key of the specified class from an xmlSecBuffer and returns a new key object.
requirements: dataId must correspond to a key data class capable of reading from buffer
buffer must be non-NULL and contain the key material in a supported format for dataId
Returned key must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReadBinaryFile
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyReadBinaryFile(xmlSecKeyDataId dataId, const char* filename);
functions.description: Reads and parses a key of the specified class from a binary file and returns a new key object.
requirements: dataId must correspond to a key data class capable of reading from file
filename must be a non-NULL, null-terminated C string path to a readable file containing key data
Returned key must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyReadMemory
functions.signature: xmlSecKeyPtr xmlSecKeyReadMemory(xmlSecKeyDataId dataId, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize);
functions.description: Parses a key of the specified class from a memory buffer and returns a new key object.
requirements: dataId must correspond to a key data class capable of reading from memory
data must be a non-NULL pointer to dataSize bytes of key material in a supported format
dataSize must be greater than 0 and within implementation limits
Returned key must be destroyed with xmlSecKeyDestroy

functions.name: xmlSecKeyPtrListGetKlass
functions.description: Returns the list class (klass) descriptor for lists of xmlSecKeyPtr elements, for use with the xmlSecPtrList API.
requirements: No arguments
Return value must be used only with compatible xmlSecPtrList operations

functions.name: xmlSecTransformIdsGet
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the global list of registered transform IDs (classes). Intended for querying or iterating over available transforms.
requirements: Callers must not free the returned list pointer; it is owned by the library.
The library must be initialized appropriately before use (implied by typical xmlsec usage).

functions.name: xmlSecTransformIdsInit
functions.description: Initializes the global registry/list of transform IDs.
requirements: Must be called before using transform ID registry functions if not initialized by a higher-level xmlsec initializer.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value and abort on error.
Should be balanced with xmlSecTransformIdsShutdown() during library shutdown.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformIdsShutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the transform ID registry and releases associated global resources.
requirements: Should be called once when cleaning up the library’s transform subsystem.
Must not be used concurrently with other registry operations.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformIdsRegisterDefault
functions.description: Registers the default set of built-in transform classes into the global registry.
requirements: Call only after xmlSecTransformIdsInit() has succeeded.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check return value.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformIdsRegister
functions.description: Registers a specific transform class (id) into the global registry.
requirements: Parameter id must be a valid transform class (non-NULL and properly constructed).
Must be called after xmlSecTransformIdsInit().
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
Registering the same id multiple times may fail (behavior depends on implementation).

functions.name: xmlSecTransformUriTypeCheck
functions.description: Checks whether a URI string matches the given xmlSecTransformUriType bitmask (e.g., empty, same-document, local, remote).
requirements: Parameter uri may be NULL only if the type mask allows empty/unspecified URIs; otherwise it should be a valid null-terminated xmlChar string.
Returns non-zero if the uri matches, 0 if it does not, and a negative value on error; caller should distinguish negative errors if needed.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxCreate
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new transform execution context.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must check the result.
The returned context must be freed with xmlSecTransformCtxDestroy().

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxDestroy
functions.description: Destroys and frees a transform execution context created by xmlSecTransformCtxCreate().
requirements: Parameter ctx may be NULL (no-op) depending on implementation; otherwise must be a context created by xmlSecTransformCtxCreate().
After this call, ctx must not be used.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxInitialize
functions.description: Initializes a pre-allocated transform context structure for use.
requirements: Parameter ctx must be a valid, zeroed or uninitialized xmlSecTransformCtx object storage.
On success returns 0; negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.
Must be finalized with xmlSecTransformCtxFinalize() before freeing or reinitializing the storage.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes a transform context previously initialized with xmlSecTransformCtxInitialize(), releasing internal resources.
requirements: Parameter ctx must have been successfully initialized by xmlSecTransformCtxInitialize().
After finalization, ctx can be re-initialized or freed; it must not be used until re-initialized.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxReset
functions.description: Resets the transform context to a clean state for re-use (clears results and chain).
requirements: Parameter ctx must be a valid initialized context.
All in-progress operations should be complete before calling reset.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxCopyUserPref
functions.description: Copies user preferences (flags, enabled URIs/transforms, callbacks, etc.) from src context to dst context.
requirements: Parameters dst and src must be valid transform contexts (typically initialized).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check the return value.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxSetUri
functions.signature: int xmlSecTransformCtxSetUri(xmlSecTransformCtxPtr ctx, const xmlChar* uri, xmlNodePtr hereNode);
functions.description: Sets the source data URI (and associated here node for same-document references) for the transform context, parsing/storing URI and XPointer parts.
requirements: Parameter ctx must be an initialized context.
Parameter uri must be a valid null-terminated xmlChar string or NULL if supported by usage.
Parameter hereNode should point to the context 'here' node in the source document when resolving same-document references.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on error; caller must check return value.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxAppend
functions.description: Appends a transform to the end of the context’s transform chain.
requirements: Parameters ctx and transform must be valid and initialized transform/context objects.
Transform must not already be in a chain.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check return value.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxPrepend
functions.description: Prepends a transform to the beginning of the context’s transform chain.
requirements: Parameters ctx and transform must be valid objects.
Transform must not be part of another chain.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check return value.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxCreateAndAppend
functions.description: Creates a transform instance of the given class id and appends it to the context’s chain.
requirements: Parameter ctx must be a valid initialized context.
Parameter id must be a valid transform class id.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check and handle errors.
The created transform is owned by the context/chain and must be removed/destroyed via context management.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxCreateAndPrepend
functions.description: Creates a transform instance and prepends it to the context’s chain.
requirements: Parameter ctx must be valid and initialized.
Parameter id must be a valid transform class id.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check the result.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxNodeRead
functions.signature: xmlSecTransformPtr xmlSecTransformCtxNodeRead(xmlSecTransformCtxPtr ctx, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecTransformUsage usage);
functions.description: Parses a <dsig:Transform/> XML node, instantiates the corresponding transform, configures it, and appends it to the context chain; returns the created transform.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
node must point to a valid transform XML element.
usage must indicate the allowed transform usages (bitmask).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check the result.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxNodesListRead
functions.signature: int xmlSecTransformCtxNodesListRead(xmlSecTransformCtxPtr ctx, xmlNodePtr node, xmlSecTransformUsage usage);
functions.description: Parses a list of transform XML nodes starting at node and adds them to the context chain according to the specified usage.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
node should reference the first transform node or a parent element containing transforms (implementation-specific).
usage must specify allowed usages.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxPrepare
functions.description: Prepares the transform chain for execution given the input data type (binary or XML), performing per-transform initialization and validation.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and contain a chain (or be ready to accept data).
inputDataType must be a valid xmlSecTransformDataType value.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxBinaryExecute
functions.signature: int xmlSecTransformCtxBinaryExecute(xmlSecTransformCtxPtr ctx, const xmlSecByte* data, xmlSecSize dataSize);
functions.description: Executes the transform chain on a single binary buffer (push model) and stores the result in ctx->result.
requirements: ctx must be prepared for binary input (e.g., via xmlSecTransformCtxPrepare()).
data must point to a buffer of size dataSize; can be NULL only if dataSize is 0.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.
Output is available in ctx->result buffer; caller should not free it.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxUriExecute
functions.description: Executes the transform chain using data loaded from the specified URI (respecting enabled URI types) and stores the result in the context.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and typically prepared; URI type must be allowed by ctx->enabledUris.
uri must be a valid null-terminated xmlChar string.
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxXmlExecute
functions.description: Executes the transform chain on an XML node set and stores the result.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and prepared for XML input if required.
nodes must be a valid node set pointer (may be NULL only if supported by chain).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxExecute
functions.description: Executes the transform chain in the context of an XML document (e.g., for same-document references), producing the result in ctx->result or via outNodes depending on chain.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and the chain prepared.
doc must be a valid libxml2 document pointer if required by the chain (may be NULL for binary-only chains).
Returns 0 on success and a negative value on failure; caller must check.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxDebugDump
functions.description: Dumps a human-readable debug representation of the transform context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid FILE* opened for writing.
ctx may be NULL; output format is for debugging only.

functions.name: xmlSecTransformCtxDebugXmlDump
functions.description: Dumps an XML-formatted debug representation of the transform context to the given FILE stream.
requirements: output must be a valid FILE* opened for writing.
Primarily intended for diagnostics; callers should not parse as stable API.
