    "urn:uuid:" + "".join(random.choice(string.hexdigits.lower()) for _ in range(32)),
    "data:;base64,",
]

def _rand_mime(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    if rnd.random() < 0.7:
        return rnd.choice(_COMMON_MIME_TYPES)
    # synthesize valid custom MIME type
    t_primary = rnd.choice(["application", "text", "image", "video", "audio", "message"])
    token_chars = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + ".-+"
    t_sub = "".join(rnd.choice(token_chars) for _ in range(rnd.randint(3, 16)))
    params = []
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        params.append(f"charset={rnd.choice(['utf-8','us-ascii','iso-8859-1'])}")
    if rnd.random() < 0.3:
        params.append(f"name=part{rnd.randint(1,999)}.bin")
    return t_primary + "/" + t_sub + (";" + ";".join(params) if params else "")

def _rand_xmldsig_type_uri(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    pools = _XMLSEC_URIS + _RSA_MGF_ALGS + _RSA_DIGEST_ALGS
    # sometimes craft a same-doc fragment to exercise Reference/@URI
    if rnd.random() < 0.25:
        frag = "#" + "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_-") for _ in range(rnd.randint(3, 12)))
        return frag
    return rnd.choice(pools)

def _rand_retrieval_uri(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    if rnd.random() < 0.6:
        return rnd.choice(_URI_SAMPLES)
    scheme = rnd.choice(["http", "https", "urn", "data"])
    if scheme in ("http", "https"):
        host = rnd.choice(["example.com", "example.org", "localhost"])
        path = "/" + "/".join(
            "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1, 8)))
            for _ in range(rnd.randint(1, 4))
        )
        tail = ("#" + "id" + str(rnd.randint(1, 9))) if rnd.random() < 0.3 else ""
        return f"{scheme}://{host}{path}{tail}"
    if scheme == "urn":
        nid = rnd.choice(["uuid", "oid", "example"])
        nss = "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits) for _ in range(rnd.randint(6, 16)))
        return f"urn:{nid}:{nss}"
    # data URI minimal
    return "data:application/octet-stream;base64,"

def _pack_strings(fields):
    # The fuzzer framework will split this buffer to satisfy successive FUZZ_PARAM_STR calls.
    # Use NUL as separator, which most fuzz harnesses accept as simple chunking.
    # Ensure total size <= 4096 bytes.
    joined = "\x00".join(fields)
    b = joined.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    return b[:4096]

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a target stub pattern to tailor field order
    # Stubs inspected require sequences of FUZZ_PARAM_STR in these orders:
    # - SignatureAddReference: id, uri, type
    # - ManifestAddReference: id, uri, type
    # - EncDataCreate: Id, Type, MimeType, Encoding
    # - KeyInfoAddRetrievalMethod: uri, type
    # - KeyInfoAddEncryptedKey: Id, Type, Recipient
    # - X509DataAddDigest: alg
    # - TransformAddRsaMgf: alg
    # - TransformAddRsaDigest: alg

    choice = rnd.choice([
        "sig_ref", "man_ref", "enc_data", "ki_rm", "ki_ek", "x509_digest", "rsa_mgf", "rsa_dig"
    ])

    fields = []
    if choice in ("sig_ref", "man_ref"):
        # Valid NCName for Id or empty; valid URI; valid Type URI or generic MIME
        make_id = rnd.random() < 0.7
        if make_id:
            start = rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + "_")
            restchars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_.-"
            rest = "".join(rnd.choice(restchars) for _ in range(rnd.randint(2, 10)))
            fields.append(start + rest)
        else:
            fields.append("")
        fields.append(_rand_retrieval_uri(rnd))
        # Use dsig type or MIME occasionally
        fields.append(_rand_xmldsig_type_uri(rnd) if rnd.random() < 0.8 else _rand_mime(rnd))

    elif choice == "enc_data":
        # Id, Type, MimeType, Encoding
        make_id = rnd.random() < 0.6
        if make_id:
            start = rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + "_")
            rest = "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_.-") for _ in range(rnd.randint(0, 10)))
            fields.append(start + rest)
        else:
            fields.append("")
        # Type is usually Element, Content, or EncryptedKey
        fields.append(rnd.choice([
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Element",
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Content",
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#EncryptedKey",
        ]))
        fields.append(_rand_mime(rnd))
        # Encoding often empty; sometimes base64 marker
        fields.append(rnd.choice(["", "base64", "quoted-printable", "binary"]))

    elif choice == "ki_rm":
        # URI (required), Type (optional)
        fields.append(_rand_retrieval_uri(rnd))
        fields.append(rnd.choice([_rand_xmldsig_type_uri(rnd), ""]))

    elif choice == "ki_ek":
        # Id, Type, Recipient
        start = rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + "_")
        rest = "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_.-") for _ in range(rnd.randint(0, 12)))
        fields.append(start + rest)
        fields.append(rnd.choice([
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Element",
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Content",
            "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#EncryptedKey",
        ]))
        # Recipient can be any token-like or email-like string
        user = "".join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits) for _ in range(rnd.randint(3,10)))
        domain = rnd.choice(["example.com", "example.org", "localhost"]) 
        fields.append(f"{user}@{domain}")

    elif choice in ("x509_digest", "rsa_mgf", "rsa_dig"):
        if choice == "x509_digest":
            fields.append(rnd.choice(_RSA_DIGEST_ALGS))
        elif choice == "rsa_mgf":
            fields.append(rnd.choice(_RSA_MGF_ALGS))
        else:
            fields.append(rnd.choice(_RSA_DIGEST_ALGS))

    else:
        # Fallback: provide a reasonable mixture
        fields = [
            _rand_mime(rnd),
            _rand_xmldsig_type_uri(rnd),
            _rand_retrieval_uri(rnd),
        ]

    return _pack_strings(fields)

import random
import string
from typing import List

# Data type: MIME type string
# This generator produces valid and interesting MIME type strings, optionally
# including parameters, suffixes, vendor and personal trees, and common types
# used by xml security contexts (e.g., application/xml, application/octet-stream).

_COMMON_TYPES: List[str] = [
    "application/xml",
    "application/octet-stream",
    "application/json",
    "application/pkcs7-mime",
    "application/pkcs8",
    "application/pkcs10",
    "application/pkix-cert",
    "application/pkcs12",
    "application/pkcs7-signature",
    "application/x-pem-file",
    "application/x-x509-ca-cert",
    "text/plain",
    "text/xml",
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
]

_TYPES: List[str] = [
    "application",
    "text",
    "image",
    "audio",
    "video",
    "font",
    "message",
    "model",
]

_SUBTYPES_COMMON: List[str] = [
    "xml",
    "json",
    "plain",
    "html",
    "javascript",
    "octet-stream",
    "pkcs7-mime",
    "pkcs7-signature",
    "pkcs8",
    "pkcs10",
    "pkix-cert",
    "x-pem-file",
    "x-x509-ca-cert",
]

_TOKEN_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "!#$&^_.+-"
_PARAM_VALUE_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "!#$&^_.+-:/"  # allow typical values


def _rand_token(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 16) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # Ensure starts with allowed token char but avoid trailing illegal
    return ''.join(rng.choice(_TOKEN_CHARS) for _ in range(n))


def _maybe_vendor_tree(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # vendor tree: vnd.<token>
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        return "vnd." + _rand_token(rng, 3, 12).lower()
    # personal tree: prs.<token>
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        return "prs." + _rand_token(rng, 3, 12).lower()
    return _rand_token(rng, 2, 10).lower()


def _maybe_suffix(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Structured syntax suffix like +xml, +json, +ber, +der
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        return "+" + rng.choice(["xml", "json", "ber", "der", "zip"])
    return ""


def _gen_parameters(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    params = []
    # Common parameters: charset, boundary, smime-type, name, filename
    # Generate between 0 and 3 parameters
    k = rng.randint(0, 3)
    for _ in range(k):
        pname = rng.choice([
            "charset", "boundary", "smime-type", "name", "filename", "protocol", "q"
        ]) if rng.random() < 0.6 else _rand_token(rng, 3, 10).lower()
        # Values may be tokens or quoted strings
        if rng.random() < 0.7:
            pval = ''.join(rng.choice(_PARAM_VALUE_CHARS) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 18)))
            # ensure no semicolons/whitespace
            pval = pval.strip(" ;\t\r\n")
            # sometimes quote
            if rng.random() < 0.3 or any(c in pval for c in '" '):
                # escape quotes if any
                pval = '"' + pval.replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
        else:
            # numeric
            pval = str(rng.randint(0, 100))
        params.append(f"{pname}={pval}")
    return (";" + ";".join(params)) if params else ""


def _gen_custom_mime(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    maintype = rng.choice(_TYPES)
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        subtype_core = rng.choice(_SUBTYPES_COMMON)
    else:
        # use vendor/prs trees more often under application/*
        if maintype == "application" and rng.random() < 0.7:
            subtype_core = _maybe_vendor_tree(rng)
        else:
            subtype_core = _rand_token(rng, 2, 12).lower()
    suffix = _maybe_suffix(rng)
    params = _gen_parameters(rng)
    return f"{maintype}/{subtype_core}{suffix}{params}"


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Bias towards common valid values first, but include variability
    if rng.random() < 0.55:
        base = rng.choice(_COMMON_TYPES)
        # maybe add a structured suffix or parameters to common ones
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            base += _maybe_suffix(rng)
        base += _gen_parameters(rng)
        s = base
    else:
        s = _gen_custom_mime(rng)

    # Ensure max size constraint
    b = s.encode('ascii', errors='ignore')[:4096]
    return b

import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets libxmlsec fuzzer stubs that call FUZZ_PARAM_STR to obtain:
# - XML Name/ID token (NCName-like) for Id attributes
# - MIME type values
# - Encoding values (e.g., base64, quoted-printable, etc.)
# - Type attribute values for EncryptedData
# The stubs also check xmlSecTransformId having attribute transform_role == "encryption" via FUZZ_SET_ATTR_STR,
# which is driven externally by the harness. Here we only provide the initial buffer consumed by FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FILENAME.
#
# Strategy:
# - Provide a concatenation of multiple newline-separated strings so that the harness can split or consume them in order.
# - Include several valid, interesting values for each category to exercise code paths.
# - Ensure first token is a valid XML ID (starts with letter or underscore; contains letters/digits/._-)
# - Provide a mix of common MIME types, XML Encryption Type URIs, and common encoding identifiers.
# - Keep total size <= 4096 bytes.

_ID_START_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + "_"
_ID_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_.-"

MIME_TYPES: List[str] = [
    "text/plain",
    "text/xml",
    "application/xml",
    "application/octet-stream",
    "application/json",
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
]

# Common XML Encryption Type URIs (examples) and generic types
ENC_TYPES: List[str] = [
    "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Element",
    "http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#Content",
    "http://www.w3.org/2009/xmlenc11#Element",
    "http://www.w3.org/2009/xmlenc11#Content",
    "Data",
    "KeyValue",
]

# Encoding names (case-insensitive typically)
ENCODINGS: List[str] = [
    "base64",
    "quoted-printable",
    "hex",
    "utf-8",
    "us-ascii",
    "binary",
]

# Additional interesting short strings for optional attributes (may be empty)
SHORTS: List[str] = [
    "",
    "id",
    "A",
    "Z_9",
    "x-attr",
]


def _rand_id(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 24) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    start = rng.choice(_ID_START_CHARS)
    rest_len = max(0, n - 1)
    rest = ''.join(rng.choice(_ID_CHARS) for _ in range(rest_len))
    return start + rest


def _maybe_empty(rng: random.Random, s: str) -> str:
    # Occasionally return empty to test optional attribute clearing
    return "" if rng.random() < 0.15 else s


def _pick(rng: random.Random, arr: List[str]) -> str:
    return rng.choice(arr)


def _unique_candidates(rng: random.Random, pool: List[str], k: int) -> List[str]:
    # Return up to k elements, with possible repeats but biased to diversity
    if not pool:
        return [""] * k
    res = []
    for _ in range(k):
        # 70% from pool, 30% create variant/case tweak
        if rng.random() < 0.7:
            res.append(_pick(rng, pool))
        else:
            base = _pick(rng, pool)
            # Randomize case for encodings and simple tokens
            if base and base.isalpha():
                modes = [str.lower, str.upper, str.title]
                res.append(rng.choice(modes)(base))
            else:
                res.append(base)
    return res


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Compose a sequence of tokens expected by the two stubs:
    # xmlSecTmplSignatureAddObject expects:
    #   1) Id
    #   2) MimeType
    #   3) Encoding
    # xmlSecTmplEncDataCreate expects:
    #   4) Id
    #   5) Type
    #   6) MimeType
    #   7) Encoding
    # We will provide more than needed to allow harness to consume additional FUZZ_PARAM_STR calls safely.

    tokens: List[str] = []

    # A few valid XML IDs
    for _ in range(3):
        tokens.append(_rand_id(rng))

    # MIME types and encodings
    tokens.extend(_unique_candidates(rng, MIME_TYPES, 4))
    tokens.extend(_unique_candidates(rng, ENCODINGS, 4))

    # Encryption Type URIs and simple types
    tokens.extend(_unique_candidates(rng, ENC_TYPES, 4))

    # Mix in some optional empties/shorts to exercise branches
    tokens.extend(_unique_candidates(rng, SHORTS, 4))

    # Shuffle a middle section but keep the very first token as a valid ID for immediate consumption
    head = tokens[:1]
    tail = tokens[1:]
    rng.shuffle(tail)
    tokens = head + tail

    # Ensure positions for the two stubs have sensible defaults if consumed in order:
    # After first ID, place a MIME and an encoding for SignatureAddObject
    # Then another ID, a type, a MIME, and an encoding for EncDataCreate
    ordered_prefix = [
        _rand_id(rng),
        _pick(rng, MIME_TYPES),
        _pick(rng, ENCODINGS),
        _rand_id(rng),
        _pick(rng, ENC_TYPES),
        _pick(rng, MIME_TYPES),
        _pick(rng, ENCODINGS),
    ]

    # Prepend ordered prefix to guarantee useful early values
    tokens = ordered_prefix + tokens

    # Occasionally inject very short and maximum-length acceptable IDs
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        tokens.insert(0, _rand_id(rng, 1, 1))
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        tokens.insert(0, _rand_id(rng, 20, 63))

    # Apply optional emptiness to some of the optional attributes (not the first token to keep initial ID valid)
    for i in range(1, min(len(tokens), 10)):
        tokens[i] = _maybe_empty(rng, tokens[i])

    # Join as newline-separated so the harness can read sequential strings
    payload = "\n".join(tokens)

    # Enforce size limit
    b = payload.encode("utf-8")[:4096]
    return b
